_leia_me: Itália. Oito aeroportos, quarenta rotas. Os preços vêm da fórmula por cidade no server.js — cada cidade tem tabela própria porque as do concorrente diferem muito entre si (Florença cobra 2,74 €/km no premium contra 1,64 de Roma). Quatro cidades — Veneza, Florença, Milão e Cagliari — não têm sedan do lado deles, e é aí que a nossa vantagem é maior. Estudo de 02/09/2026.

airports.name: Rome Fiumicino Airport
airports.about: Fiumicino sits thirty kilometres from the centre, on the coast. Terminal 3 handles almost all international arrivals, and the walk from the far gates to the taxi rank is longer than most people expect — allow twenty minutes from wheels down to the kerb.
tips: Terminal 3 for international arrivals, Terminal 1 for Italian and short-haul Schengen. The two are ten minutes apart on foot.
The taxi fare to the centre is fixed by the city at €55, but that covers the historic centre only. Anywhere outside the Aurelian walls and the meter starts again.
The Leonardo Express runs to Termini in thirty-two minutes. It is fast, but Termini is not where most hotels are, and the second leg with luggage is the part nobody plans for.
local: The €55 fixed taxi fare, and where it stops

Rome caps the airport taxi fare to the historic centre. It is a good deal if that is where you are going. Outside the walls — Trastevere south of Viale Trastevere, the Vatican museums area, Monteverde — the cap does not apply and the meter runs. Our price is the same wherever inside the city you are heading.
Two roads in, and both fill up

The A91 and the Via Portuense both feed into the centre and both queue between 07:00 and 09:30. The GRA ring road adds fifteen minutes but often saves more. Your driver decides on the day; the fare does not change either way.
Cruise passengers going to Civitavecchia
Seventy kilometres north, about an hour, and the road is straightforward. Book it as a transfer rather than a taxi — the taxi meter on that route is unpredictable and there is no fixed fare.
compare: No traffic, and it runs every 15 minutes.
Termini is rarely the final stop. Steps, crowds and a second journey with bags.
Regulated price to the historic centre.
The cap ends at the Aurelian walls. Outside them, the meter runs and the price is unknown.
Stops everywhere. No luggage space at peak times.

destinations.name: Rome city centre
destinations.about: Twenty-seven kilometres, and between forty and sixty minutes depending on the hour. The centre is a limited-traffic zone — our licensed vehicles are cleared to enter, which is not true of a hire car. Give the street name and the number: Via del Corso alone runs for a kilometre and a half.

es.name: Centro de Roma
es.about: Veintisiete kilómetros, entre cuarenta y sesenta minutos según la hora. El centro es zona de tráfico limitado: nuestros vehículos con licencia pueden entrar, cosa que no ocurre con un coche de alquiler. Danos la calle y el número.

pt.name: Centro de Roma
pt.about: Vinte e sete quilómetros, entre quarenta e sessenta minutos conforme a hora. O centro é zona de trânsito limitado: os nossos veículos licenciados podem entrar, ao contrário de um carro alugado. Dê-nos a rua e o número.

fr.name: Centre de Rome
fr.about: Vingt-sept kilomètres, entre quarante et soixante minutes selon l'heure. Le centre est une zone à trafic limité : nos véhicules agréés peuvent y entrer, contrairement à une voiture de location. Donnez-nous la rue et le numéro.

destinations.name: Ostia
destinations.about: Eight kilometres south along the coast, fifteen minutes. Ostia Antica — the Roman port ruins — is a separate stop from Ostia Lido, the beach town. Say which one you mean when you book; they are four kilometres apart and the drivers know the difference.

es.name: Ostia
es.about: Ocho kilómetros al sur por la costa, quince minutos. Ostia Antica —las ruinas del puerto romano— es una parada distinta de Ostia Lido, el pueblo de playa. Indica cuál quieres al reservar.

pt.name: Ostia
pt.about: Oito quilómetros para sul pela costa, quinze minutos. Ostia Antica — as ruínas do porto romano — é uma paragem diferente de Ostia Lido, a vila balnear. Diga qual quer ao reservar.

fr.name: Ostie
fr.about: Huit kilomètres au sud le long de la côte, quinze minutes. Ostia Antica — les ruines du port romain — est un arrêt distinct d'Ostia Lido, la station balnéaire. Précisez laquelle à la réservation.

destinations.name: Civitavecchia
destinations.about: Seventy-three kilometres north on the A12, about an hour. This is the cruise port for Rome, and the terminals are spread along two kilometres of quay — tell us the ship and the driver takes you to the right gate rather than the port entrance.

es.name: Civitavecchia
es.about: Setenta y tres kilómetros al norte por la A12, alrededor de una hora. Es el puerto de cruceros de Roma y las terminales se reparten por dos kilómetros de muelle: dinos el barco y el conductor te lleva a la puerta correcta.

pt.name: Civitavecchia
pt.about: Setenta e três quilómetros para norte pela A12, cerca de uma hora. É o porto de cruzeiros de Roma e os terminais espalham-se por dois quilómetros de cais: diga-nos o navio e o motorista leva-o ao portão certo.

fr.name: Civitavecchia
fr.about: Soixante-treize kilomètres au nord par l'A12, environ une heure. C'est le port de croisière de Rome et les terminaux s'étendent sur deux kilomètres de quai : dites-nous le navire et le chauffeur vous dépose à la bonne porte.

destinations.name: Orvieto
destinations.about: A hundred and twenty-four kilometres north on the A1, an hour and a half. The old town sits on a plug of volcanic rock and cars cannot climb the last stretch — the drop-off is at the funicular station or the Campo della Fiera car park, whichever you prefer.

es.name: Orvieto
es.about: Ciento veinticuatro kilómetros al norte por la A1, hora y media. El casco antiguo está sobre una roca volcánica y los coches no suben el último tramo: la parada es en el funicular o en el aparcamiento de Campo della Fiera.

pt.name: Orvieto
pt.about: Cento e vinte e quatro quilómetros para norte pela A1, hora e meia. A cidade velha fica sobre uma rocha vulcânica e os carros não sobem o último troço: a paragem é no funicular ou no parque do Campo della Fiera.

fr.name: Orvieto
fr.about: Cent vingt-quatre kilomètres au nord par l'A1, une heure et demie. La vieille ville est perchée sur un rocher volcanique et les voitures ne montent pas le dernier tronçon : la dépose se fait au funiculaire ou au parking Campo della Fiera.

destinations.name: Naples
destinations.about: Two hundred and thirty-four kilometres south on the A1, two and a half hours. Long enough that the train is usually the better choice — but for a family with luggage, or an arrival after the last connection, the door-to-door price is fixed and there is no changing platforms at Termini.

es.name: Nápoles
es.about: Doscientos treinta y cuatro kilómetros al sur por la A1, dos horas y media. Suele salir mejor el tren, pero para una familia con equipaje, o una llegada después del último enlace, el precio puerta a puerta es fijo.

pt.name: Nápoles
pt.about: Duzentos e trinta e quatro quilómetros para sul pela A1, duas horas e meia. Costuma compensar o comboio, mas para uma família com bagagem, ou uma chegada depois da última ligação, o preço porta a porta é fixo.

fr.name: Naples
fr.about: Deux cent trente-quatre kilomètres au sud par l'A1, deux heures et demie. Le train est souvent préférable, mais pour une famille avec bagages, ou une arrivée après la dernière correspondance, le prix porte-à-porte est fixe.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Roma Fiumicino
es.about: Fiumicino está a treinta kilómetros del centro, en la costa. La Terminal 3 recibe casi todas las llegadas internacionales, y el paseo desde las puertas más lejanas hasta la parada de taxis es más largo de lo que parece.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Roma Fiumicino
pt.about: Fiumicino fica a trinta quilómetros do centro, na costa. O Terminal 3 recebe quase todas as chegadas internacionais, e a caminhada das portas mais distantes até à praça de táxis é maior do que parece.

fr.name: Aéroport de Rome Fiumicino
fr.about: Fiumicino se trouve à trente kilomètres du centre, sur la côte. Le terminal 3 accueille presque toutes les arrivées internationales, et la marche depuis les portes les plus éloignées jusqu'à la station de taxis est plus longue qu'on ne le pense.

airports.name: Milan Malpensa Airport
airports.about: Malpensa is fifty kilometres north-west of Milan, which surprises people who booked it thinking it was the city airport. Terminal 1 takes long-haul and most international flights; Terminal 2 is low-cost, and the two are four kilometres apart.
tips: Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 are linked by a free shuttle every seven minutes. It takes ten minutes, and you need it if you land at the wrong one.
The Malpensa Express runs to Cadorna and Centrale. Cadorna is closer to the Duomo; Centrale is where the high-speed trains leave from.
There is no fixed taxi fare from Malpensa. The meter runs, and €90 to €110 into the centre is normal.
local: It is not the Milan airport people expect

Fifty kilometres and fifty minutes on a clear road. Linate is the one eight kilometres from the centre. If your meeting is at nine and you land at eight at Malpensa, the arithmetic does not work — plan for it.
The lakes are closer than the city
Como is fifty kilometres, Stresa on Lake Maggiore is forty. If the lakes are why you are coming, Malpensa is the right airport and the transfer is shorter than the one into Milan.
Fashion week and the Salone
Twice a year the city fills and the taxi queues at Malpensa run to an hour. Those are the weeks when a booked car matters most, and the weeks when they get booked first.
compare: Two stations to choose between, and a second journey from either.
No fixed fare. Traffic on the A8 is charged to you.
Fills up. Bags in the hold. One stop only.

destinations.name: Milan city centre
destinations.about: Forty-eight kilometres on the A8, fifty minutes when it moves and eighty when it does not. Central Milan is a congestion-charge zone — Area C — and the charge is included in the fare. Give the street number: the one-way system means a hundred metres can cost five minutes.

es.name: Centro de Milán
es.about: Cuarenta y ocho kilómetros por la A8, cincuenta minutos si circula y ochenta si no. El centro es zona de peaje urbano, Area C, y el cargo va incluido en la tarifa.

pt.name: Centro de Milão
pt.about: Quarenta e oito quilómetros pela A8, cinquenta minutos quando anda e oitenta quando não anda. O centro é zona de portagem urbana, a Area C, e a taxa está incluída no preço.

fr.name: Centre de Milan
fr.about: Quarante-huit kilomètres par l'A8, cinquante minutes quand ça roule et quatre-vingts quand ça bouchonne. Le centre est une zone à péage urbain, l'Area C, et la taxe est comprise dans le tarif.

destinations.name: Como
destinations.about: Fifty kilometres north, fifty minutes, and the last stretch runs along the lake. If you are going to Bellagio or Varenna the road narrows and slows considerably — worth allowing an extra half hour beyond what a map suggests.

es.name: Como
es.about: Cincuenta kilómetros al norte, cincuenta minutos, y el último tramo bordea el lago. Si vas a Bellagio o Varenna la carretera se estrecha: cuenta con media hora más.

pt.name: Como
pt.about: Cinquenta quilómetros para norte, cinquenta minutos, e o último troço acompanha o lago. Se vai para Bellagio ou Varenna a estrada estreita: conte com mais meia hora.

fr.name: Côme
fr.about: Cinquante kilomètres au nord, cinquante minutes, et le dernier tronçon longe le lac. Pour Bellagio ou Varenna la route se rétrécit : comptez une demi-heure de plus.

destinations.name: Bergamo
destinations.about: Eighty-seven kilometres east, an hour and ten. The Città Alta sits above the modern town and cars are restricted inside the walls — the drop-off is at Porta Sant'Agostino or the funicular, both a short walk from the old streets.

es.name: Bérgamo
es.about: Ochenta y siete kilómetros al este, una hora y diez. La Città Alta está sobre la ciudad nueva y los coches tienen restricciones dentro de las murallas.

pt.name: Bérgamo
pt.about: Oitenta e sete quilómetros para leste, uma hora e dez. A Città Alta fica sobre a cidade nova e os carros têm restrições dentro das muralhas.

fr.name: Bergame
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-sept kilomètres à l'est, une heure dix. La Città Alta domine la ville basse et les voitures sont limitées à l'intérieur des remparts.

destinations.name: Verona
destinations.about: A hundred and sixty-three kilometres east on the A4, close to two hours. Long, and the train is often quicker — but for an opera night at the Arena that ends near midnight, a car waiting is worth more than the time saved.

es.name: Verona
es.about: Ciento sesenta y tres kilómetros al este por la A4, casi dos horas. El tren suele ser más rápido, pero para una noche de ópera en la Arena que acaba a medianoche, un coche esperando vale más.

pt.name: Verona
pt.about: Cento e sessenta e três quilómetros para leste pela A4, quase duas horas. O comboio costuma ser mais rápido, mas para uma noite de ópera na Arena que acaba à meia-noite, um carro à espera vale mais.

fr.name: Vérone
fr.about: Cent soixante-trois kilomètres à l'est par l'A4, près de deux heures. Le train est souvent plus rapide, mais pour une soirée d'opéra aux Arènes qui finit à minuit, une voiture qui attend vaut mieux.

destinations.name: Turin
destinations.about: A hundred and forty-six kilometres west, an hour and three quarters. The A4 runs the whole way and is dull but quick. Turin has its own airport, but the connections through Malpensa are better and the transfer closes the gap.

es.name: Turín
es.about: Ciento cuarenta y seis kilómetros al oeste, una hora y tres cuartos. La A4 va todo el camino y es aburrida pero rápida.

pt.name: Turim
pt.about: Cento e quarenta e seis quilómetros para oeste, uma hora e três quartos. A A4 vai todo o caminho e é aborrecida mas rápida.

fr.name: Turin
fr.about: Cent quarante-six kilomètres à l'ouest, une heure trois quarts. L'A4 fait tout le trajet, monotone mais rapide.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Milán Malpensa
es.about: Malpensa está a cincuenta kilómetros al noroeste de Milán, lo que sorprende a quien lo reservó pensando que era el aeropuerto de la ciudad.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Milão Malpensa
pt.about: Malpensa fica a cinquenta quilómetros a noroeste de Milão, o que surpreende quem o reservou a pensar que era o aeroporto da cidade.

fr.name: Aéroport de Milan Malpensa
fr.about: Malpensa se trouve à cinquante kilomètres au nord-ouest de Milan, ce qui surprend ceux qui l'ont réservé en croyant que c'était l'aéroport de la ville.

airports.name: Venice Marco Polo Airport
airports.about: Marco Polo is thirteen kilometres from Venice, on the mainland. No car reaches the historic centre — the road ends at Piazzale Roma, and from there it is a boat or a walk. That is not a limitation of the transfer; it is how the city works.
tips: Piazzale Roma is where every car stops. From there, a vaporetto, a water taxi, or your own two feet with the bags.
If your hotel is on the Grand Canal, a water taxi from the airport dock may suit you better than a road transfer. Ask us and we will say so.
Mestre is on the mainland, ten minutes from the airport, and half the price of a Venice hotel. Many people stay there without realising it is an option.
local: The car stops at Piazzale Roma

There is no road into Venice proper. Every land vehicle — taxi, bus, private car — ends at the same square. What matters is how far your hotel is from there, and whether you are carrying bags over bridges.
Water taxi or road transfer

A water taxi from the airport dock costs €120 to €140 and takes thirty minutes to most of the centre. A road transfer to Piazzale Roma costs a fraction of that. Which is better depends entirely on where you are sleeping.
Mestre, and why people stay there
Ten minutes from the airport, on the mainland, with trains into Venice every ten minutes. Rooms cost half. If you are visiting for three days and not two, the sums usually favour it.
compare: Bags in the hold. Crowded when three flights land together.
Door to door, if your door is on a canal.
Expensive. Rough in bad weather. Not every hotel has a dock.
Slow, with many stops. Luggage space is limited.

destinations.name: Venice Piazzale Roma
destinations.about: Thirteen kilometres across the causeway, twenty minutes. This is as close as a car gets to Venice. From Piazzale Roma the vaporetto lines run the length of the Grand Canal, and the People Mover connects to the cruise terminal in three minutes.

es.name: Venecia Piazzale Roma
es.about: Trece kilómetros por el puente, veinte minutos. Es lo más cerca que un coche llega de Venecia. Desde Piazzale Roma salen los vaporettos por el Gran Canal.

pt.name: Veneza Piazzale Roma
pt.about: Treze quilómetros pela ponte, vinte minutos. É o mais perto que um carro chega de Veneza. De Piazzale Roma partem os vaporettos ao longo do Grande Canal.

fr.name: Venise Piazzale Roma
fr.about: Treize kilomètres par le pont, vingt minutes. C'est au plus près qu'une voiture approche de Venise. De Piazzale Roma partent les vaporettos le long du Grand Canal.

destinations.name: Mestre
destinations.about: Eleven kilometres, under twenty minutes. Mestre is the mainland half of Venice — ordinary, cheaper, and ten minutes from the island by train. If your hotel is here, the transfer goes to the door rather than to a square.

es.name: Mestre
es.about: Once kilómetros, menos de veinte minutos. Mestre es la mitad continental de Venecia: normal, más barata, y a diez minutos de la isla en tren.

pt.name: Mestre
pt.about: Onze quilómetros, menos de vinte minutos. Mestre é a metade continental de Veneza: normal, mais barata, e a dez minutos da ilha de comboio.

fr.name: Mestre
fr.about: Onze kilomètres, moins de vingt minutes. Mestre est la moitié continentale de Venise : ordinaire, moins chère, et à dix minutes de l'île en train.

destinations.name: Padua
destinations.about: Forty-six kilometres west, forty-five minutes. Padua has the Scrovegni Chapel and a university older than most countries. It is also a common base for people who find Venice hotels too dear and the trains too crowded.

es.name: Padua
es.about: Cuarenta y seis kilómetros al oeste, cuarenta y cinco minutos. Padua tiene la Capilla de los Scrovegni y una universidad más antigua que muchos países.

pt.name: Pádua
pt.about: Quarenta e seis quilómetros para oeste, quarenta e cinco minutos. Pádua tem a Capela dos Scrovegni e uma universidade mais antiga do que muitos países.

fr.name: Padoue
fr.about: Quarante-six kilomètres à l'ouest, quarante-cinq minutes. Padoue possède la chapelle des Scrovegni et une université plus ancienne que bien des pays.

destinations.name: Verona
destinations.about: A hundred and twenty-two kilometres west on the A4, an hour and a half. Worth booking rather than training when the Arena season is on and the last train back leaves before the opera ends.

es.name: Verona
es.about: Ciento veintidós kilómetros al oeste por la A4, hora y media. Merece la pena reservar en temporada de la Arena, cuando el último tren sale antes de que acabe la ópera.

pt.name: Verona
pt.about: Cento e vinte e dois quilómetros para oeste pela A4, hora e meia. Compensa reservar na época da Arena, quando o último comboio parte antes de a ópera acabar.

fr.name: Vérone
fr.about: Cent vingt-deux kilomètres à l'ouest par l'A4, une heure et demie. À réserver pendant la saison des Arènes, quand le dernier train part avant la fin de l'opéra.

destinations.name: Treviso
destinations.about: Twenty-eight kilometres north, half an hour. Treviso has its own low-cost airport, but people often fly into Marco Polo and travel across. The old centre is walled and partly canalled — quieter than Venice and far cheaper.

es.name: Treviso
es.about: Veintiocho kilómetros al norte, media hora. Treviso tiene su propio aeropuerto de bajo coste, pero mucha gente llega a Marco Polo y cruza.

pt.name: Treviso
pt.about: Vinte e oito quilómetros para norte, meia hora. Treviso tem aeroporto próprio de baixo custo, mas muita gente chega a Marco Polo e atravessa.

fr.name: Trévise
fr.about: Vingt-huit kilomètres au nord, une demi-heure. Trévise a son propre aéroport low-cost, mais beaucoup atterrissent à Marco Polo et font le trajet.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Venecia Marco Polo
es.about: Marco Polo está a trece kilómetros de Venecia, en tierra firme. Ningún coche llega al centro histórico: la carretera termina en Piazzale Roma.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Veneza Marco Polo
pt.about: Marco Polo fica a treze quilómetros de Veneza, em terra firme. Nenhum carro chega ao centro histórico: a estrada acaba em Piazzale Roma.

fr.name: Aéroport de Venise Marco Polo
fr.about: Marco Polo se trouve à treize kilomètres de Venise, sur la terre ferme. Aucune voiture n'atteint le centre historique : la route s'arrête à Piazzale Roma.

airports.name: Catania Airport
airports.about: Fontanarossa is seven kilometres from Catania, with Etna filling the view to the north. It is the busiest airport in Sicily and the arrivals hall is small for the traffic it takes.
tips: Seven kilometres to the centre, fifteen minutes when it moves.
Taormina is sixty kilometres north and the coast motorway is quick.
Etna excursions leave from Rifugio Sapienza, at 1,900 metres. The road up closes in snow.
local: Etna, and the road up it
Forty-five kilometres to Rifugio Sapienza, an hour with the climb. The cable car goes higher. Eruptions close the road occasionally and the closure is decided that morning.
Taormina sits above the sea
Sixty kilometres north, and the town is three hundred metres up a hairpin road. Cars stop at Porta Messina; the centre is pedestrian.
The baroque south-east
Noto, Modica and Ragusa were rebuilt after the 1693 earthquake and are UNESCO listed together. Ninety kilometres, and a full day.
compare: Direct to the station and the port.
Two stops. Crowded when flights land together.
No fixed fare. Traffic on the SS114 is charged to you.
You have to get to the station first.

destinations.name: Catania city centre
destinations.about: Seven kilometres, fifteen minutes when it moves and half an hour when it does not. Catania is built in black lava stone and the centre is a UNESCO site. Via Etnea is the spine, and most hotels are within a block of it.

es.name: Centro de Catania
es.about: Siete kilómetros, quince minutos si circula y media hora si no. Catania está construida en piedra de lava negra y el centro es Patrimonio de la Humanidad. La Via Etnea es el eje y casi todos los hoteles están a una manzana.

pt.name: Centro de Catânia
pt.about: Sete quilómetros, quinze minutos se andar e meia hora se não andar. Catânia é construída em pedra de lava negra e o centro é Património Mundial. A Via Etnea é o eixo e quase todos os hotéis estão a um quarteirão.

fr.name: Centre de Catane
fr.about: Sept kilomètres, quinze minutes quand ça roule et une demi-heure sinon. Catane est bâtie en pierre de lave noire et le centre est classé au patrimoine mondial. La Via Etnea en est l'axe.

destinations.name: Taormina
destinations.about: Sixty kilometres north on the coast motorway, fifty-five minutes. The town sits three hundred metres up a road of hairpins, and cars stop at Porta Messina — the centre beyond is pedestrian, and the walk in is level.

es.name: Taormina
es.about: Sesenta kilómetros al norte por la autopista de la costa, cincuenta y cinco minutos. El pueblo está trescientos metros más arriba por una carretera de curvas, y los coches paran en Porta Messina: el centro es peatonal y llano.

pt.name: Taormina
pt.about: Sessenta quilómetros para norte pela autoestrada da costa, cinquenta e cinco minutos. A vila fica trezentos metros acima por uma estrada de curvas, e os carros param na Porta Messina: o centro é pedonal e plano.

fr.name: Taormine
fr.about: Soixante kilomètres au nord par l'autoroute côtière, cinquante-cinq minutes. Le village est trois cents mètres plus haut par une route en lacets, et les voitures s'arrêtent à Porta Messina : le centre est piéton et plat.

destinations.name: Syracuse
destinations.about: Sixty-five kilometres south, fifty-five minutes. Ortigia, the island that is the old town, is joined to the mainland by two bridges and closed to non-resident traffic. The drop-off is at the bridge.

es.name: Siracusa
es.about: Sesenta y cinco kilómetros al sur, cincuenta y cinco minutos. Ortigia, la isla que es el casco antiguo, se une a tierra por dos puentes y está cerrada al tráfico ajeno. La parada es en el puente.

pt.name: Siracusa
pt.about: Sessenta e cinco quilómetros para sul, cinquenta e cinco minutos. Ortigia, a ilha que é o centro velho, liga-se a terra por duas pontes e está fechada ao trânsito alheio. A paragem é na ponte.

fr.name: Syracuse
fr.about: Soixante-cinq kilomètres au sud, cinquante-cinq minutes. Ortygie, l'île qui forme la vieille ville, est reliée par deux ponts et fermée aux non-résidents. La dépose se fait au pont.

destinations.name: Mount Etna
destinations.about: Forty-five kilometres and an hour, most of it climbing. Rifugio Sapienza at 1,900 metres is where the cable car and the excursions start. The road closes in snow and sometimes for an eruption — we check before setting off.

es.name: Etna
es.about: Cuarenta y cinco kilómetros y una hora, casi todo subiendo. El Rifugio Sapienza, a 1.900 metros, es donde empiezan el teleférico y las excursiones. La carretera cierra con nieve y a veces por una erupción.

pt.name: Etna
pt.about: Quarenta e cinco quilómetros e uma hora, quase tudo a subir. O Rifugio Sapienza, a 1.900 metros, é onde começam o teleférico e as excursões. A estrada fecha com neve e às vezes por uma erupção.

fr.name: Etna
fr.about: Quarante-cinq kilomètres et une heure, presque tout en montée. Le Rifugio Sapienza, à 1 900 mètres, est le départ du téléphérique et des excursions. La route ferme sous la neige et parfois pour une éruption.

destinations.name: Noto
destinations.about: Ninety kilometres south, an hour and ten. Noto was rebuilt in golden limestone after the 1693 earthquake and the whole town is baroque. The main street is closed to cars in the evening, which is when it looks best.

es.name: Noto
es.about: Noventa kilómetros al sur, una hora y diez. Noto se reconstruyó en piedra dorada tras el terremoto de 1693 y el pueblo entero es barroco. La calle principal se cierra al tráfico por la tarde, que es cuando mejor se ve.

pt.name: Noto
pt.about: Noventa quilómetros para sul, uma hora e dez. Noto foi reconstruída em pedra dourada depois do terramoto de 1693 e a vila inteira é barroca. A rua principal fecha ao trânsito à tarde, que é quando melhor se vê.

fr.name: Noto
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-dix kilomètres au sud, une heure dix. Noto fut rebâtie en pierre dorée après le séisme de 1693 et toute la ville est baroque. La rue principale ferme à la circulation le soir, quand elle est la plus belle.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Catania
es.about: Fontanarossa is seven kilometres from Catania, with Etna filling the view to the north. It is the busiest airport in Sicily and the arrivals hall is small for the traffic it takes.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Catânia
pt.about: Fontanarossa is seven kilometres from Catania, with Etna filling the view to the north. It is the busiest airport in Sicily and the arrivals hall is small for the traffic it takes.

fr.name: Aéroport de Catane
fr.about: Fontanarossa is seven kilometres from Catania, with Etna filling the view to the north. It is the busiest airport in Sicily and the arrivals hall is small for the traffic it takes.

airports.name: Bergamo Airport
airports.about: Orio al Serio is five kilometres from Bergamo and fifty from Milan, which is why it is signposted as Milan Bergamo. It is one of Europe's busiest low-cost airports and the arrivals hall shows it.
tips: Five kilometres to Bergamo, twelve minutes. Fifty-two to Milan, close to an hour.
The Città Alta is above the modern town and cars are restricted inside the walls.
Buses to Milan Centrale run every twenty minutes and take an hour.
local: Called Milan, but it is Bergamo
Fifty-two kilometres to Milan and an hour on a good day. If your meeting is in Milan and you land here, plan for it — a lot of people do not.
The Città Alta
Bergamo's upper town is walled, Venetian, and reached by funicular or a steep road. Cars stop at Porta Sant'Agostino.
Lake Iseo and the Franciacorta
Forty kilometres east: the smallest of the big lakes, and the sparkling wine region beside it. Much quieter than Como.
compare: An hour, and Centrale is not everyone's destination.
Door to door at any hour.
No fixed fare, and the A4 tolls are added.

destinations.name: Bergamo city centre
destinations.about: Five kilometres, twelve minutes. The Città Alta is above the modern town, inside Venetian walls, and reached by funicular or a steep road with restrictions. Cars stop at Porta Sant'Agostino.

es.name: Centro de Bérgamo
es.about: Cinco kilómetros, doce minutos. La Città Alta está por encima de la ciudad nueva, dentro de murallas venecianas, y se llega en funicular o por una carretera empinada con restricciones. Los coches paran en Porta Sant'Agostino.

pt.name: Centro de Bérgamo
pt.about: Cinco quilómetros, doze minutos. A Città Alta fica acima da cidade nova, dentro de muralhas venezianas, e chega-se de funicular ou por uma estrada íngreme com restrições. Os carros param na Porta Sant'Agostino.

fr.name: Centre de Bergame
fr.about: Cinq kilomètres, douze minutes. La Città Alta domine la ville basse, à l'intérieur de remparts vénitiens, et s'atteint par funiculaire ou par une route escarpée réglementée. Les voitures s'arrêtent à Porta Sant'Agostino.

destinations.name: Milan city centre
destinations.about: Fifty-two kilometres west, close to an hour on the A4. The airport is signposted as Milan Bergamo, which misleads a lot of people — if your meeting is in the city, this is the arithmetic to do first.

es.name: Centro de Milán
es.about: Cincuenta y dos kilómetros al oeste, cerca de una hora por la A4. El aeropuerto se anuncia como Milán Bérgamo, lo que despista a mucha gente: si tu reunión es en la ciudad, esta es la cuenta que hay que hacer primero.

pt.name: Centro de Milão
pt.about: Cinquenta e dois quilómetros para oeste, perto de uma hora pela A4. O aeroporto anuncia-se como Milão Bérgamo, o que engana muita gente: se a sua reunião é na cidade, esta é a conta a fazer primeiro.

fr.name: Centre de Milan
fr.about: Cinquante-deux kilomètres à l'ouest, près d'une heure par l'A4. L'aéroport s'annonce comme Milan Bergame, ce qui trompe beaucoup de monde : si votre rendez-vous est en ville, c'est le calcul à faire d'abord.

destinations.name: Como
destinations.about: Seventy-five kilometres north-west, an hour and ten. Como town is at the southern tip of the lake. For Bellagio or Varenna the road narrows and adds half an hour on top of what a map suggests.

es.name: Como
es.about: Setenta y cinco kilómetros al noroeste, una hora y diez. Como está en la punta sur del lago. Para Bellagio o Varenna la carretera se estrecha y añade media hora sobre lo que dice el mapa.

pt.name: Como
pt.about: Setenta e cinco quilómetros para noroeste, uma hora e dez. Como fica na ponta sul do lago. Para Bellagio ou Varenna a estrada estreita e acrescenta meia hora ao que o mapa diz.

fr.name: Côme
fr.about: Soixante-quinze kilomètres au nord-ouest, une heure dix. Côme est à la pointe sud du lac. Pour Bellagio ou Varenna la route se rétrécit et ajoute une demi-heure à ce qu'annonce la carte.

destinations.name: Brescia
destinations.about: Fifty kilometres east on the A4, forty-five minutes. Brescia has a Roman forum, a Lombard monastery and almost no tourists. It shared the title of Italian Capital of Culture in 2023.

es.name: Brescia
es.about: Cincuenta kilómetros al este por la A4, cuarenta y cinco minutos. Brescia tiene un foro romano, un monasterio lombardo y casi ningún turista. Fue capital italiana de la cultura en 2023.

pt.name: Brescia
pt.about: Cinquenta quilómetros para leste pela A4, quarenta e cinco minutos. Brescia tem um fórum romano, um mosteiro lombardo e quase nenhum turista. Foi capital italiana da cultura em 2023.

fr.name: Brescia
fr.about: Cinquante kilomètres à l'est par l'A4, quarante-cinq minutes. Brescia a un forum romain, un monastère lombard et presque aucun touriste. Capitale italienne de la culture en 2023.

destinations.name: Lake Garda
destinations.about: Seventy-five kilometres east, an hour and five to the southern shore. Sirmione, Desenzano and Peschiera are all within twenty kilometres of each other once you arrive.

es.name: Lago de Garda
es.about: Setenta y cinco kilómetros al este, una hora y cinco hasta la orilla sur. Sirmione, Desenzano y Peschiera están a menos de veinte kilómetros una de otra al llegar.

pt.name: Lago de Garda
pt.about: Setenta e cinco quilómetros para leste, uma hora e cinco até à margem sul. Sirmione, Desenzano e Peschiera ficam a menos de vinte quilómetros umas das outras quando se chega.

fr.name: Lac de Garde
fr.about: Soixante-quinze kilomètres à l'est, une heure cinq jusqu'à la rive sud. Sirmione, Desenzano et Peschiera sont à moins de vingt kilomètres les unes des autres une fois arrivé.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Bérgamo
es.about: Orio al Serio is five kilometres from Bergamo and fifty from Milan, which is why it is signposted as Milan Bergamo. It is one of Europe's busiest low-cost airports and the arrivals hall shows it.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Bérgamo
pt.about: Orio al Serio is five kilometres from Bergamo and fifty from Milan, which is why it is signposted as Milan Bergamo. It is one of Europe's busiest low-cost airports and the arrivals hall shows it.

fr.name: Aéroport de Bergame
fr.about: Orio al Serio is five kilometres from Bergamo and fifty from Milan, which is why it is signposted as Milan Bergamo. It is one of Europe's busiest low-cost airports and the arrivals hall shows it.

airports.name: Naples Airport
airports.about: Capodichino sits inside the city, six kilometres from the port. That is unusual and convenient, but it also means the road out is city traffic from the first metre — twelve kilometres to the centre can take forty minutes.
tips: The airport is in the city, not outside it. There is no motorway stretch to make up time.
For the Amalfi Coast, the road narrows past Sorrento and buses cannot pass each other in places. Allow more time than a map suggests.
The Alibus to the port and Piazza Garibaldi costs €5 and takes twenty-five minutes.
local: City traffic from the gate
Capodichino has no ring road. Every journey starts in Naples traffic, which is dense and improvisational. Our price is fixed; the taxi meter is not, and the difference shows on a bad day.
The Amalfi Coast road
Beautiful, and slow. The stretch from Sorrento to Positano is single-lane in places with buses coming the other way. Ninety minutes is realistic for a journey a map calls sixty.
Pompeii and Herculaneum
Pompeii is twenty-eight kilometres, Herculaneum fifteen. Both are on the Circumvesuviana line, which is cheap and often unpleasant with luggage. For a family, the car wins.
compare: Direct, and it serves both the station and the port.
Two stops only. Crowded and slow in traffic.
Fixed fares exist for some destinations.
The fixed list is not well advertised. Ask before setting off.
The cheapest way to the ruins.
No airport station. Crowded, hot, and hard with bags.

destinations.name: Naples city centre
destinations.about: Twelve kilometres, but twenty-five to forty minutes depending on the hour. The historic centre is a UNESCO site with streets built for carts — the driver gets as close as the street allows, and tells you where that is before you set off.

es.name: Centro de Nápoles
es.about: Doce kilómetros, pero entre veinticinco y cuarenta minutos según la hora. El centro histórico tiene calles hechas para carros.

pt.name: Centro de Nápoles
pt.about: Doze quilómetros, mas entre vinte e cinco e quarenta minutos conforme a hora. O centro histórico tem ruas feitas para carroças.

fr.name: Centre de Naples
fr.about: Douze kilomètres, mais de vingt-cinq à quarante minutes selon l'heure. Le centre historique a des rues faites pour des charrettes.

destinations.name: Pompeii
destinations.about: Twenty-eight kilometres south-east, thirty-five minutes. The site has three entrances and they are a kilometre apart — Porta Marina for the main route, Piazza Anfiteatro for the quieter one. Say which you want and the driver takes you there.

es.name: Pompeya
es.about: Veintiocho kilómetros al sureste, treinta y cinco minutos. El yacimiento tiene tres entradas separadas por un kilómetro: Porta Marina para la ruta principal.

pt.name: Pompeia
pt.about: Vinte e oito quilómetros para sudeste, trinta e cinco minutos. O sítio tem três entradas a um quilómetro umas das outras: a Porta Marina para o percurso principal.

fr.name: Pompéi
fr.about: Vingt-huit kilomètres au sud-est, trente-cinq minutes. Le site a trois entrées distantes d'un kilomètre : Porta Marina pour le parcours principal.

destinations.name: Sorrento
destinations.about: Sixty-three kilometres around the bay, an hour and ten. The last twenty kilometres are the slow part — the coast road is narrow and busy from June to September. Sorrento is also the ferry port for Capri.

es.name: Sorrento
es.about: Sesenta y tres kilómetros bordeando la bahía, una hora y diez. Los últimos veinte kilómetros son los lentos: la carretera de la costa es estrecha.

pt.name: Sorrento
pt.about: Sessenta e três quilómetros a contornar a baía, uma hora e dez. Os últimos vinte quilómetros são os lentos: a estrada da costa é estreita.

fr.name: Sorrente
fr.about: Soixante-trois kilomètres autour de la baie, une heure dix. Les vingt derniers kilomètres sont les plus lents : la route côtière est étroite.

destinations.name: Salerno
destinations.about: Seventy-six kilometres south on the motorway, an hour. Salerno is the eastern gateway to the Amalfi Coast and the ferry port for Amalfi and Positano in summer — often faster than the coast road, and considerably calmer.

es.name: Salerno
es.about: Setenta y seis kilómetros al sur por autopista, una hora. Salerno es la puerta oriental a la Costa Amalfitana y el puerto de ferry en verano.

pt.name: Salerno
pt.about: Setenta e seis quilómetros para sul pela autoestrada, uma hora. Salerno é a porta oriental da Costa Amalfitana e o porto de ferry no verão.

fr.name: Salerne
fr.about: Soixante-seize kilomètres au sud par l'autoroute, une heure. Salerne est la porte orientale de la côte amalfitaine et le port de ferry en été.

destinations.name: Amalfi
destinations.about: Eighty kilometres, and an hour and a half — the distance is short and the road is the reason. Hairpins, buses, and no overtaking for the last thirty kilometres. Worth every minute, and worth booking a driver who has done it before.

es.name: Amalfi
es.about: Ochenta kilómetros, y hora y media: la distancia es corta y la culpa es de la carretera. Curvas cerradas, autobuses y nada de adelantar en los últimos treinta kilómetros.

pt.name: Amalfi
pt.about: Oitenta quilómetros, e hora e meia — a distância é curta e a culpa é da estrada. Curvas apertadas, autocarros, e nada de ultrapassar nos últimos trinta quilómetros.

fr.name: Amalfi
fr.about: Quatre-vingts kilomètres, et une heure et demie : la distance est courte, c'est la route qui est en cause. Épingles, autocars et aucun dépassement sur les trente derniers kilomètres.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Nápoles
es.about: Capodichino está dentro de la ciudad, a seis kilómetros del puerto. Es cómodo, pero también significa tráfico urbano desde el primer metro.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Nápoles
pt.about: Capodichino fica dentro da cidade, a seis quilómetros do porto. É cómodo, mas significa também trânsito urbano desde o primeiro metro.

fr.name: Aéroport de Naples
fr.about: Capodichino se trouve dans la ville, à six kilomètres du port. C'est pratique, mais cela signifie aussi de la circulation urbaine dès le premier mètre.

airports.name: Rome Ciampino Airport
airports.about: Ciampino is small, close and almost entirely low-cost. One terminal, one arrivals hall, and you are outside within ten minutes of landing. It is fifteen kilometres from the centre, but the road in is slower than the distance suggests.
tips: One terminal. Arrivals and departures share the same hall, and it gets crowded when two flights land together.
The fixed taxi fare from Ciampino to the historic centre is €40 — again, only to inside the walls.
There is no train station at the airport. Every route out involves a bus or a car.
local: Closer than Fiumicino, not always faster

Fifteen kilometres against thirty, but the Via Appia Nuova and the Tuscolana both run through built-up areas with traffic lights. At rush hour a Ciampino transfer can take as long as one from Fiumicino.
The Castelli Romani are on the doorstep
Frascati, Castel Gandolfo and Albano are all within twenty kilometres. If you are heading to the hills rather than the city, Ciampino is much the better arrival airport.
Late arrivals
Low-cost schedules put a lot of flights in after 23:00. The last bus to Termini goes at 00:15 and the taxi queue at that hour is long. A booked transfer waits regardless of when you land.
compare: Cheap, and it runs to schedule.
Only to Termini. No service after 00:15. Bags go in the hold and come out slowly.
Queues after late arrivals. Outside the walls the meter runs.
Two vehicles, one change, and steps at the metro with luggage.

destinations.name: Rome city centre
destinations.about: Thirty-four kilometres by the ring road, or fifteen straight through the suburbs — the driver takes whichever is moving. Forty minutes on a good day, an hour at five in the afternoon. The centre is a limited-traffic zone and our vehicles are cleared for it.

es.name: Centro de Roma
es.about: Treinta y cuatro kilómetros por la circunvalación, o quince directos por los suburbios: el conductor toma la que esté despejada. Cuarenta minutos en un buen día, una hora a las cinco de la tarde.

pt.name: Centro de Roma
pt.about: Trinta e quatro quilómetros pela circular, ou quinze diretos pelos subúrbios — o motorista escolhe o que estiver a andar. Quarenta minutos num bom dia, uma hora às cinco da tarde.

fr.name: Centre de Rome
fr.about: Trente-quatre kilomètres par le périphérique, ou quinze en traversant la banlieue : le chauffeur prend ce qui roule. Quarante minutes un bon jour, une heure à dix-sept heures.

destinations.name: Frascati
destinations.about: Twelve kilometres uphill into the Castelli Romani, twenty minutes. The old centre is closed to traffic during the day — the drop-off is at Piazza Marconi, a two-minute walk from most of the town.

es.name: Frascati
es.about: Doce kilómetros cuesta arriba hacia los Castelli Romani, veinte minutos. El casco antiguo está cerrado al tráfico de día: la parada es en Piazza Marconi.

pt.name: Frascati
pt.about: Doze quilómetros a subir para os Castelli Romani, vinte minutos. O centro velho está fechado ao trânsito de dia: a paragem é na Piazza Marconi.

fr.name: Frascati
fr.about: Douze kilomètres en montée vers les Castelli Romani, vingt minutes. Le vieux centre est fermé à la circulation en journée : la dépose se fait Piazza Marconi.

destinations.name: Castel Gandolfo
destinations.about: Fifteen kilometres, twenty-five minutes, and the road climbs the whole way. The town sits above Lake Albano and the papal palace is now open to visitors. Parking near the centre is scarce, which is an argument for being dropped rather than driving.

es.name: Castel Gandolfo
es.about: Quince kilómetros, veinticinco minutos, subiendo todo el camino. El pueblo domina el lago Albano y el palacio papal ya se puede visitar. Aparcar cerca del centro es difícil.

pt.name: Castel Gandolfo
pt.about: Quinze quilómetros, vinte e cinco minutos, a subir todo o caminho. A vila fica sobre o lago Albano e o palácio papal já se pode visitar. Estacionar perto do centro é difícil.

fr.name: Castel Gandolfo
fr.about: Quinze kilomètres, vingt-cinq minutes, en montée tout du long. Le village domine le lac Albano et le palais papal se visite désormais. Se garer près du centre est difficile.

destinations.name: Tivoli
destinations.about: Thirty-five kilometres east, forty minutes. Villa d'Este and Villa Adriana are six kilometres apart and both take half a day — if you are visiting both, an hourly booking usually works out better than two transfers.

es.name: Tívoli
es.about: Treinta y cinco kilómetros al este, cuarenta minutos. Villa d'Este y Villa Adriana están a seis kilómetros y cada una lleva media jornada.

pt.name: Tivoli
pt.about: Trinta e cinco quilómetros para leste, quarenta minutos. A Villa d'Este e a Villa Adriana estão a seis quilómetros uma da outra e cada uma leva meio dia.

fr.name: Tivoli
fr.about: Trente-cinq kilomètres à l'est, quarante minutes. La Villa d'Este et la Villa Adriana sont à six kilomètres l'une de l'autre et prennent chacune une demi-journée.

destinations.name: Anzio
destinations.about: Forty-eight kilometres south to the coast, fifty minutes. Anzio is the ferry port for Ponza — if you are catching the boat, tell us the sailing time and the driver plans the departure backwards from it.

es.name: Anzio
es.about: Cuarenta y ocho kilómetros al sur hacia la costa, cincuenta minutos. Anzio es el puerto de ferry a Ponza: si vas a coger el barco, dinos la hora de salida.

pt.name: Anzio
pt.about: Quarenta e oito quilómetros para sul até à costa, cinquenta minutos. Anzio é o porto de ferry para Ponza: se vai apanhar o barco, diga-nos a hora da partida.

fr.name: Anzio
fr.about: Quarante-huit kilomètres au sud vers la côte, cinquante minutes. Anzio est le port de ferry pour Ponza : si vous prenez le bateau, indiquez-nous l'heure du départ.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Roma Ciampino
es.official: Aeropuerto de Roma Ciampino–G. B. Pastine
es.about: Ciampino es pequeño, cercano y casi todo de bajo coste. Una sola terminal, y sales a la calle diez minutos después de aterrizar.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Roma Ciampino
pt.official: Aeroporto de Roma Ciampino–G. B. Pastine
pt.about: Ciampino é pequeno, perto e quase todo de baixo custo. Um só terminal, e está na rua dez minutos depois de aterrar.

fr.name: Aéroport de Rome Ciampino
fr.official: Aéroport de Rome Ciampino–G. B. Pastine
fr.about: Ciampino est petit, proche et presque entièrement low-cost. Un seul terminal, et vous êtes dehors dix minutes après l'atterrissage.

airports.name: Bologna Airport
airports.about: Marconi is six kilometres from the centre, connected by an elevated monorail that opened in 2020. Bologna is also the junction of Italy's rail network, which makes the airport a common arrival point for people going somewhere else entirely.
tips: The Marconi Express monorail runs to the central station in seven minutes, every seven minutes, for €11.
Bologna Centrale is the crossroads of Italian rail. Florence is thirty-five minutes, Milan an hour, Venice ninety minutes.
The centre has forty kilometres of covered arcades. It rains in Emilia and nobody carries an umbrella.
local: A hub for somewhere else

A lot of people land at Bologna and leave immediately — for Florence, for Rimini, for the Adriatic coast. The airport is well placed for it, and a transfer beats a train when there are three of you with cases.
The motor valley
Ferrari at Maranello, Lamborghini at Sant'Agata, Ducati in the city. All within an hour, all doable in a day with a car and a driver who knows the roads.
Fiera district and the trade fairs
Cosmoprof, Cersaie, Motor Show. During fair weeks the hotels fill for forty kilometres around and the taxi queue at the airport runs long. Book ahead in those weeks.
compare: Ends at the station. A second journey from there, usually.
Short trip and a modest fare.
Queues at peak arrival times. Supplements after 22:00.

destinations.name: Bologna city centre
destinations.about: Ten kilometres, twenty minutes. The centre is a limited-traffic zone and the arcaded streets are narrow — the driver takes you to the door, but the door may be on a street where stopping is a matter of seconds rather than minutes.

es.name: Centro de Bolonia
es.about: Diez kilómetros, veinte minutos. El centro es zona de tráfico limitado y las calles porticadas son estrechas.

pt.name: Centro de Bolonha
pt.about: Dez quilómetros, vinte minutos. O centro é zona de trânsito limitado e as ruas com arcadas são estreitas.

fr.name: Centre de Bologne
fr.about: Dix kilomètres, vingt minutes. Le centre est une zone à trafic limité et les rues à arcades sont étroites.

destinations.name: Modena
destinations.about: Fifty-four kilometres west, forty-five minutes. Modena is balsamic vinegar, Ferrari and one of the finest restaurants in the world. The Enzo Ferrari museum is in the town; the Maranello factory is another twenty minutes south.

es.name: Módena
es.about: Cincuenta y cuatro kilómetros al oeste, cuarenta y cinco minutos. Módena es vinagre balsámico, Ferrari y uno de los mejores restaurantes del mundo.

pt.name: Módena
pt.about: Cinquenta e quatro quilómetros para oeste, quarenta e cinco minutos. Módena é vinagre balsâmico, Ferrari e um dos melhores restaurantes do mundo.

fr.name: Modène
fr.about: Cinquante-quatre kilomètres à l'ouest, quarante-cinq minutes. Modène, c'est le vinaigre balsamique, Ferrari et l'un des meilleurs restaurants du monde.

destinations.name: Ferrara
destinations.about: Fifty-two kilometres north-east, forty-five minutes. A Renaissance town that stayed intact, with a moated castle in the middle of it and more bicycles than cars. Flat, walkable, and rarely crowded.

es.name: Ferrara
es.about: Cincuenta y dos kilómetros al noreste, cuarenta y cinco minutos. Una ciudad renacentista intacta, con un castillo rodeado de foso y más bicicletas que coches.

pt.name: Ferrara
pt.about: Cinquenta e dois quilómetros para nordeste, quarenta e cinco minutos. Uma cidade renascentista intacta, com um castelo rodeado de fosso e mais bicicletas do que carros.

fr.name: Ferrare
fr.about: Cinquante-deux kilomètres au nord-est, quarante-cinq minutes. Une ville Renaissance intacte, avec un château entouré de douves et plus de vélos que de voitures.

destinations.name: Rimini
destinations.about: A hundred and twenty kilometres south-east to the Adriatic, an hour and a half. Rimini is fifteen kilometres of beach and the gateway to San Marino. In August the coast road slows considerably — the motorway is the better run.

es.name: Rímini
es.about: Ciento veinte kilómetros al sureste hacia el Adriático, hora y media. Rímini son quince kilómetros de playa y la puerta a San Marino.

pt.name: Rimini
pt.about: Cento e vinte quilómetros para sudeste até ao Adriático, hora e meia. Rimini são quinze quilómetros de praia e a porta para São Marinho.

fr.name: Rimini
fr.about: Cent vingt kilomètres au sud-est vers l'Adriatique, une heure et demie. Rimini, c'est quinze kilomètres de plage et la porte de Saint-Marin.

destinations.name: Florence
destinations.about: A hundred and fifteen kilometres south over the Apennines, an hour and twenty. The A1 climbs and tunnels the whole way. The train does it in thirty-five minutes, so this transfer makes sense for luggage, groups, or arrivals after the last service.

es.name: Florencia
es.about: Ciento quince kilómetros al sur cruzando los Apeninos, una hora y veinte. El tren tarda treinta y cinco minutos, así que este traslado tiene sentido con equipaje o en grupo.

pt.name: Florença
pt.about: Cento e quinze quilómetros para sul pelos Apeninos, uma hora e vinte. O comboio faz em trinta e cinco minutos, por isso este transfer faz sentido com bagagem ou em grupo.

fr.name: Florence
fr.about: Cent quinze kilomètres au sud à travers les Apennins, une heure vingt. Le train met trente-cinq minutes : ce transfert se justifie avec des bagages ou en groupe.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Bolonia
es.about: Marconi está a seis kilómetros del centro, conectado por un monorraíl elevado. Bolonia es además el nudo ferroviario de Italia.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Bolonha
pt.about: Marconi fica a seis quilómetros do centro, ligado por um monocarril elevado. Bolonha é também o nó ferroviário de Itália.

fr.name: Aéroport de Bologne
fr.about: Marconi est à six kilomètres du centre, relié par un monorail aérien. Bologne est aussi le nœud ferroviaire de l'Italie.

airports.name: Pisa Airport
airports.about: Pisa's airport is three kilometres from the leaning tower, which makes it one of the closest in Europe. It is also the practical gateway to Florence for anyone flying low-cost, and to the Cinque Terre up the coast.
tips: The PisaMover shuttle runs to Pisa Centrale in five minutes.
Florence is eighty-five kilometres east — an hour by road, an hour by train.
The Cinque Terre are reached by train from La Spezia. Cars cannot enter the villages.
local: Closer to the tower than most hotels
Three kilometres. You can walk it in forty minutes, and people do. With luggage, twelve minutes in a car.
The low-cost gateway to Florence

Many people fly into Pisa for Florence because the fares are lower. Eighty-five kilometres, an hour on the FI-PI-LI. The train takes the same time and costs less; the car wins with bags or after the last service.
Cinque Terre without a car
The villages are closed to non-resident traffic. The transfer goes to La Spezia or Levanto, and the local train does the rest — five stops, ten minutes between each.
compare: Station only, and a second journey from there.
Small queues, but they form after each arrival.
Change at Pisa Centrale. Crowded and no luggage racks at peak.

destinations.name: Pisa city centre
destinations.about: Three kilometres, ten minutes. The airport is closer to the leaning tower than most hotels are — you can walk it in forty minutes, and people do. With bags, the car takes a quarter of that.

es.name: Centro de Pisa
es.about: Tres kilómetros, diez minutos. El aeropuerto está más cerca de la torre que la mayoría de los hoteles: se puede ir andando en cuarenta minutos, y hay quien lo hace. Con maletas, el coche tarda una cuarta parte.

pt.name: Centro de Pisa
pt.about: Três quilómetros, dez minutos. O aeroporto está mais perto da torre do que a maioria dos hotéis: dá para ir a pé em quarenta minutos, e há quem vá. Com malas, o carro leva um quarto disso.

fr.name: Centre de Pise
fr.about: Trois kilomètres, dix minutes. L'aéroport est plus près de la tour que la plupart des hôtels : on y va à pied en quarante minutes, et certains le font. Avec des bagages, la voiture met le quart.

destinations.name: Florence
destinations.about: Eighty-five kilometres east on the FI-PI-LI, an hour. The train takes about the same and costs less; the car wins when there are three of you with cases, or when the last service has gone.

es.name: Florencia
es.about: Ochenta y cinco kilómetros al este por la FI-PI-LI, una hora. El tren tarda lo mismo y cuesta menos; el coche gana cuando sois tres con maletas, o cuando ya no hay tren.

pt.name: Florença
pt.about: Oitenta e cinco quilómetros para leste pela FI-PI-LI, uma hora. O comboio demora o mesmo e custa menos; o carro ganha quando são três com malas, ou quando já não há comboio.

fr.name: Florence
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-cinq kilomètres à l'est par la FI-PI-LI, une heure. Le train met autant et coûte moins ; la voiture l'emporte à trois avec des valises, ou après le dernier départ.

destinations.name: Lucca
destinations.about: Twenty-five kilometres north, half an hour. Lucca's Renaissance walls are intact and wide enough to cycle round. Cars stop outside the gates, which is a short walk from anywhere inside.

es.name: Lucca
es.about: Veinticinco kilómetros al norte, media hora. Las murallas renacentistas de Lucca están enteras y son lo bastante anchas para recorrerlas en bici. Los coches paran fuera de las puertas, a un paseo corto de todo.

pt.name: Lucca
pt.about: Vinte e cinco quilómetros para norte, meia hora. As muralhas renascentistas de Lucca estão inteiras e são largas o suficiente para se percorrerem de bicicleta. Os carros param fora das portas, a curta distância de tudo.

fr.name: Lucques
fr.about: Vingt-cinq kilomètres au nord, une demi-heure. Les remparts Renaissance de Lucques sont intacts et assez larges pour en faire le tour à vélo. Les voitures s'arrêtent hors des portes, à quelques pas de tout.

destinations.name: Cinque Terre
destinations.about: A hundred and fifteen kilometres up the coast, an hour and a half. The five villages are closed to non-resident cars — the transfer ends at La Spezia or Levanto and the local train does the last part, ten minutes between each.

es.name: Cinque Terre
es.about: Ciento quince kilómetros por la costa, hora y media. Los cinco pueblos están cerrados a los coches de fuera: el traslado acaba en La Spezia o Levanto y el tren local hace el resto, diez minutos entre cada uno.

pt.name: Cinque Terre
pt.about: Cento e quinze quilómetros pela costa, hora e meia. As cinco aldeias estão fechadas a carros de fora: o transfer acaba em La Spezia ou Levanto e o comboio local faz o resto, dez minutos entre cada uma.

fr.name: Cinque Terre
fr.about: Cent quinze kilomètres le long de la côte, une heure et demie. Les cinq villages sont fermés aux voitures extérieures : le transfert s'arrête à La Spezia ou Levanto et le train local fait le reste.

destinations.name: Viareggio
destinations.about: Thirty kilometres north, half an hour. Viareggio is a long seafront of art nouveau bathing houses and the carnival in February is one of the biggest in Italy. Flat, and easy to reach.

es.name: Viareggio
es.about: Treinta kilómetros al norte, media hora. Viareggio es un paseo marítimo largo de casetas de baño modernistas, y el carnaval de febrero es de los mayores de Italia. Llano y fácil de alcanzar.

pt.name: Viareggio
pt.about: Trinta quilómetros para norte, meia hora. Viareggio é uma marginal comprida de casas de banho arte nova, e o carnaval de fevereiro é dos maiores de Itália. Plano e fácil de alcançar.

fr.name: Viareggio
fr.about: Trente kilomètres au nord, une demi-heure. Viareggio, c'est un long front de mer aux cabines Art nouveau, et le carnaval de février est l'un des plus grands d'Italie. Plat et facile d'accès.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Pisa
es.about: Pisa's airport is three kilometres from the leaning tower, which makes it one of the closest in Europe. It is also the practical gateway to Florence for anyone flying low-cost, and to the Cinque Terre up the coast.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Pisa
pt.about: Pisa's airport is three kilometres from the leaning tower, which makes it one of the closest in Europe. It is also the practical gateway to Florence for anyone flying low-cost, and to the Cinque Terre up the coast.

fr.name: Aéroport de Pise
fr.about: Pisa's airport is three kilometres from the leaning tower, which makes it one of the closest in Europe. It is also the practical gateway to Florence for anyone flying low-cost, and to the Cinque Terre up the coast.

airports.name: Cagliari Airport
airports.about: Elmas is nine kilometres from Cagliari, on the edge of a lagoon where flamingos feed. Sardinia is bigger than people expect — the beaches on the Costa Rei are an hour away, and the north of the island is four.
tips: Nine kilometres to the city, fifteen minutes. The train to Cagliari Centrale takes seven and runs every twenty.
Sardinia is 270 kilometres long. Check the distance to your hotel before assuming it is close.
In August the coast roads to Villasimius and Chia slow considerably from mid-morning.
local: The island is longer than it looks
Cagliari is at the southern tip. Olbia and the Costa Smeralda are four hours north by road. If your hotel is up there, flying into Olbia is the better plan.
Flamingos at the runway
The Molentargius wetland sits between the airport and the city, and the flamingos are there most of the year. You see them on the approach.
Beaches, and the road to them
Villasimius is sixty-six kilometres east on a coast road that narrows and winds. Chia is sixty south, and the last stretch is the same. Both are worth the drive; neither is quick.
compare: Only to the station. Every 20 minutes, less at night.
Queues after arrivals. No fixed fare to the beaches.
Parking in Cagliari is scarce. Beach car parks charge in summer.

destinations.name: Cagliari city centre
destinations.about: Nine kilometres across the lagoon, fifteen minutes. Cagliari climbs from the port to the Castello district, and the old streets up there are too narrow and too steep for a car — the drop-off is at the foot of the walls, and the lift does the rest.

es.name: Centro de Cagliari
es.about: Nueve kilómetros cruzando la laguna, quince minutos. Cagliari sube desde el puerto hasta el Castello, y esas calles son demasiado estrechas y empinadas para un coche: la parada es al pie de las murallas y el ascensor hace el resto.

pt.name: Centro de Cagliari
pt.about: Nove quilómetros a atravessar a lagoa, quinze minutos. Cagliari sobe do porto até ao Castello, e essas ruas são estreitas e íngremes de mais para um carro: a paragem é ao pé das muralhas e o elevador faz o resto.

fr.name: Centre de Cagliari
fr.about: Neuf kilomètres à travers la lagune, quinze minutes. Cagliari grimpe du port jusqu'au Castello, et ces rues sont trop étroites et trop raides pour une voiture : la dépose se fait au pied des remparts, l'ascenseur fait le reste.

destinations.name: Villasimius
destinations.about: Sixty-six kilometres east on the coast road, an hour. The road is beautiful and slow, with the sea on one side most of the way. In August it queues from mid-morning; before nine it is empty.

es.name: Villasimius
es.about: Sesenta y seis kilómetros al este por la carretera de la costa, una hora. Es bonita y lenta, con el mar al lado casi todo el camino. En agosto se llena desde media mañana; antes de las nueve está vacía.

pt.name: Villasimius
pt.about: Sessenta e seis quilómetros para leste pela estrada da costa, uma hora. É bonita e lenta, com o mar ao lado quase todo o caminho. Em agosto enche a partir do meio da manhã; antes das nove está vazia.

fr.name: Villasimius
fr.about: Soixante-six kilomètres à l'est par la route côtière, une heure. Belle et lente, avec la mer à côté presque tout du long. En août elle sature dès la fin de matinée ; avant neuf heures elle est vide.

destinations.name: Chia
destinations.about: Sixty kilometres south-west, under an hour. Chia is dunes, juniper and a Phoenician tower on the headland. The hotels are spread along ten kilometres of coast, so the exact name matters more than usual.

es.name: Chia
es.about: Sesenta kilómetros al suroeste, menos de una hora. Chia son dunas, enebros y una torre fenicia en el cabo. Los hoteles se reparten por diez kilómetros de costa, así que el nombre exacto importa más de lo normal.

pt.name: Chia
pt.about: Sessenta quilómetros para sudoeste, menos de uma hora. Chia são dunas, zimbros e uma torre fenícia no cabo. Os hotéis espalham-se por dez quilómetros de costa, por isso o nome exato importa mais do que o normal.

fr.name: Chia
fr.about: Soixante kilomètres au sud-ouest, moins d'une heure. Chia, ce sont des dunes, des genévriers et une tour phénicienne sur le cap. Les hôtels s'étalent sur dix kilomètres de côte : le nom exact compte plus que d'habitude.

destinations.name: Costa Rei
destinations.about: Sixty-five kilometres east, an hour and five. Past Villasimius the road turns inland and then back to the sea. Costa Rei is a long stretch of white sand with very little behind it, which is the point.

es.name: Costa Rei
es.about: Sesenta y cinco kilómetros al este, una hora y cinco. Pasado Villasimius la carretera se aleja del mar y vuelve. Costa Rei es una franja larga de arena blanca con muy poco detrás, que es justo el atractivo.

pt.name: Costa Rei
pt.about: Sessenta e cinco quilómetros para leste, uma hora e cinco. Passado Villasimius a estrada afasta-se do mar e volta. Costa Rei é uma faixa longa de areia branca com muito pouco atrás, que é justamente o atrativo.

fr.name: Costa Rei
fr.about: Soixante-cinq kilomètres à l'est, une heure cinq. Après Villasimius la route s'éloigne de la mer puis y revient. Costa Rei est une longue bande de sable blanc avec très peu derrière, et c'est tout l'intérêt.

destinations.name: Oristano
destinations.about: Ninety-five kilometres north on the SS131, an hour and ten. Oristano is the base for the Sinis peninsula and the Roman ruins at Tharros. The motorway does most of it, so the time is predictable.

es.name: Oristano
es.about: Noventa y cinco kilómetros al norte por la SS131, una hora y diez. Oristano es la base para la península del Sinis y las ruinas romanas de Tharros. La autovía hace casi todo, así que el tiempo es predecible.

pt.name: Oristano
pt.about: Noventa e cinco quilómetros para norte pela SS131, uma hora e dez. Oristano é a base para a península do Sinis e as ruínas romanas de Tharros. A via rápida faz quase tudo, por isso o tempo é previsível.

fr.name: Oristano
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-quinze kilomètres au nord par la SS131, une heure dix. Oristano est la base pour la péninsule du Sinis et les ruines romaines de Tharros. La voie rapide fait presque tout, le temps est donc prévisible.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Cagliari
es.about: Elmas is nine kilometres from Cagliari, on the edge of a lagoon where flamingos feed. Sardinia is bigger than people expect — the beaches on the Costa Rei are an hour away, and the north of the island is four.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Cagliari
pt.about: Elmas is nine kilometres from Cagliari, on the edge of a lagoon where flamingos feed. Sardinia is bigger than people expect — the beaches on the Costa Rei are an hour away, and the north of the island is four.

fr.name: Aéroport de Cagliari
fr.about: Elmas is nine kilometres from Cagliari, on the edge of a lagoon where flamingos feed. Sardinia is bigger than people expect — the beaches on the Costa Rei are an hour away, and the north of the island is four.

airports.name: Palermo Airport
airports.about: Punta Raisi sits on a strip of land between the mountains and the sea, thirty-five kilometres west of Palermo. The approach is spectacular and the drive in follows the coast most of the way.
tips: Thirty-five kilometres to the city, about forty minutes on the A29.
The Trinacria Express train runs to Palermo Centrale in an hour, but only once or twice an hour.
For Cefalù or the west coast, going straight from the airport saves doubling back through the city.
local: The coast road, and the motorway
The A29 runs inland and is quick. The old coast road through Isola delle Femmine is slower and much better looking. Tell the driver if you would rather see it — the fare is the same.
Cefalù without going through Palermo
Eighty-five kilometres east, and the route bypasses the city entirely. A transfer straight from the airport saves an hour against going in and out again.
The temples at Agrigento
A hundred and thirty kilometres south, two hours across the middle of the island. Long, but the Valley of the Temples is one of the great Greek sites and the road there is empty.
compare: Cheap, and it avoids the motorway.
One or two an hour. Slow, and the station is not central for most hotels.
Bags in the hold. Three stops, none of them your hotel.
No fixed fare. Expect the higher end at night and on Sundays.

destinations.name: Palermo city centre
destinations.about: Thirty-five kilometres on the A29, forty minutes. The historic centre is dense and the streets around the Vucciria and Ballarò markets are barely wide enough for a car — the driver will say where the nearest stopping point is.

es.name: Centro de Palermo
es.about: Treinta y cinco kilómetros por la A29, cuarenta minutos. El centro histórico es denso y las calles junto a los mercados apenas dan para un coche.

pt.name: Centro de Palermo
pt.about: Trinta e cinco quilómetros pela A29, quarenta minutos. O centro histórico é denso e as ruas junto aos mercados mal dão para um carro.

fr.name: Centre de Palerme
fr.about: Trente-cinq kilomètres par l'A29, quarante minutes. Le centre historique est dense et les rues autour des marchés font à peine la largeur d'une voiture.

destinations.name: Mondello
destinations.about: Twenty-three kilometres, half an hour. Mondello is Palermo's beach — a crescent of white sand under Monte Pellegrino, with art nouveau villas behind it. In August the road in queues from midday.

es.name: Mondello
es.about: Veintitrés kilómetros, media hora. Mondello es la playa de Palermo: una media luna de arena blanca bajo el Monte Pellegrino.

pt.name: Mondello
pt.about: Vinte e três quilómetros, meia hora. Mondello é a praia de Palermo: uma meia-lua de areia branca sob o Monte Pellegrino.

fr.name: Mondello
fr.about: Vingt-trois kilomètres, une demi-heure. Mondello est la plage de Palerme : un croissant de sable blanc sous le Monte Pellegrino.

destinations.name: Cefalù
destinations.about: Eighty-five kilometres east along the coast, an hour and ten. The route bypasses Palermo entirely, which saves an hour against going in and out. The old town is closed to traffic and the drop-off is at the edge of it.

es.name: Cefalù
es.about: Ochenta y cinco kilómetros al este por la costa, una hora y diez. La ruta evita Palermo, lo que ahorra una hora frente a entrar y salir.

pt.name: Cefalù
pt.about: Oitenta e cinco quilómetros para leste pela costa, uma hora e dez. O caminho evita Palermo, o que poupa uma hora face a entrar e sair.

fr.name: Cefalù
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-cinq kilomètres à l'est le long de la côte, une heure dix. L'itinéraire évite Palerme, ce qui fait gagner une heure.

destinations.name: Trapani
destinations.about: Ninety-five kilometres west, an hour and a quarter. Trapani is the port for the Egadi islands and the salt pans stretch along the coast south of it. Erice, the medieval town on the mountain above, is another twenty minutes up.

es.name: Trapani
es.about: Noventa y cinco kilómetros al oeste, hora y cuarto. Trapani es el puerto de las islas Égadas y las salinas se extienden por la costa al sur.

pt.name: Trapani
pt.about: Noventa e cinco quilómetros para oeste, hora e um quarto. Trapani é o porto das ilhas Égadas e as salinas estendem-se pela costa a sul.

fr.name: Trapani
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-quinze kilomètres à l'ouest, une heure et quart. Trapani est le port des îles Égades et les salines s'étendent sur la côte au sud.

destinations.name: Agrigento
destinations.about: A hundred and thirty kilometres south, nearly two hours across the middle of Sicily. The Valley of the Temples is the reason to go — seven Doric temples in a row, better preserved than most of what stands in Greece.

es.name: Agrigento
es.about: Ciento treinta kilómetros al sur, casi dos horas cruzando Sicilia. El Valle de los Templos es el motivo: siete templos dóricos en fila.

pt.name: Agrigento
pt.about: Cento e trinta quilómetros para sul, quase duas horas a atravessar a Sicília. O Vale dos Templos é a razão: sete templos dóricos em fila.

fr.name: Agrigente
fr.about: Cent trente kilomètres au sud, près de deux heures à traverser la Sicile. La Vallée des Temples en est la raison : sept temples doriques alignés.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Palermo
es.about: Punta Raisi está sobre una franja de tierra entre las montañas y el mar, a treinta y cinco kilómetros al oeste de Palermo.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Palermo
pt.about: Punta Raisi fica sobre uma faixa de terra entre as montanhas e o mar, a trinta e cinco quilómetros a oeste de Palermo.

fr.name: Aéroport de Palerme
fr.about: Punta Raisi occupe une bande de terre entre les montagnes et la mer, à trente-cinq kilomètres à l'ouest de Palerme.

airports.name: Bari Airport
airports.about: Bari Karol Wojtyła is nine kilometres from the city and connected by a train that runs to the central station in fourteen minutes. Puglia spreads out from here — the trulli, the coast, and Matera an hour inland.
tips: The Ferrotramviaria train runs to Bari Centrale in fourteen minutes for €5.
Alberobello and the trulli are sixty kilometres south-east.
Bari is a ferry port for Greece, Albania and Croatia. The terminal is four kilometres from the airport.
local: The trulli at Alberobello
Sixty kilometres, an hour. Fifteen hundred conical stone houses, and the town is a UNESCO site. Parking is at the edge and the centre is walked.
Matera is in another region
Seventy kilometres west, over the border into Basilicata. The sassi — cave dwellings carved into the ravine — were inhabited until the 1950s.
The ferry port
Four kilometres from the airport. If you are sailing to Dubrovnik or Corfu, check the boarding time rather than the departure: they close the gate ninety minutes before.
compare: Hourly, and less on Sundays. Station only.
Slow in traffic. Bags in the hold.
Fixed fares exist to some destinations.
The list is not well advertised. Ask first.

destinations.name: Bari city centre
destinations.about: Nine kilometres, twenty minutes. Bari Vecchia — the old town — is a maze of alleys where the women still make orecchiette in the doorways. Cars stop at the edge; inside, it is walked.

es.name: Centro de Bari
es.about: Nueve kilómetros, veinte minutos. Bari Vecchia es un laberinto de callejones donde las mujeres siguen haciendo orecchiette en las puertas. Los coches paran al borde; dentro se anda.

pt.name: Centro de Bari
pt.about: Nove quilómetros, vinte minutos. Bari Vecchia é um labirinto de vielas onde as mulheres ainda fazem orecchiette às portas. Os carros param à entrada; lá dentro anda-se a pé.

fr.name: Centre de Bari
fr.about: Neuf kilomètres, vingt minutes. Bari Vecchia est un dédale de ruelles où les femmes font encore les orecchiette sur le pas de la porte. Les voitures s'arrêtent en lisière ; à l'intérieur, on marche.

destinations.name: Alberobello
destinations.about: Sixty kilometres south-east, an hour. Fifteen hundred trulli, the conical stone houses, and the two districts are on opposite sides of the town. Say which one your hotel is in — Rione Monti or Aia Piccola.

es.name: Alberobello
es.about: Sesenta kilómetros al sureste, una hora. Mil quinientos trulli, las casas cónicas de piedra, y los dos barrios están en lados opuestos del pueblo. Dinos cuál: Rione Monti o Aia Piccola.

pt.name: Alberobello
pt.about: Sessenta quilómetros para sudeste, uma hora. Mil e quinhentos trulli, as casas cónicas de pedra, e os dois bairros ficam em lados opostos da vila. Diga-nos qual: Rione Monti ou Aia Piccola.

fr.name: Alberobello
fr.about: Soixante kilomètres au sud-est, une heure. Mille cinq cents trulli, ces maisons coniques en pierre, et les deux quartiers sont de part et d'autre du village. Dites-nous lequel : Rione Monti ou Aia Piccola.

destinations.name: Polignano a Mare
destinations.about: Forty-five kilometres south, forty minutes. Polignano is built on a cliff over a cove, and the town beach is at the bottom of a ravine. Parking near the centre is scarce all summer.

es.name: Polignano a Mare
es.about: Cuarenta y cinco kilómetros al sur, cuarenta minutos. Polignano está sobre un acantilado encima de una cala, y la playa del pueblo está al fondo de un barranco. Aparcar cerca del centro es difícil todo el verano.

pt.name: Polignano a Mare
pt.about: Quarenta e cinco quilómetros para sul, quarenta minutos. Polignano fica sobre uma falésia por cima de uma enseada, e a praia da vila está no fundo de uma ravina. Estacionar perto do centro é difícil todo o verão.

fr.name: Polignano a Mare
fr.about: Quarante-cinq kilomètres au sud, quarante minutes. Polignano est perchée sur une falaise au-dessus d'une crique, et la plage du village est au fond d'un ravin. Se garer près du centre est difficile tout l'été.

destinations.name: Matera
destinations.about: Seventy kilometres west into Basilicata, an hour. The sassi are cave dwellings carved into a ravine, inhabited until the 1950s and now hotels. Many are reached only on foot down steps — send the name and we find the nearest road.

es.name: Matera
es.about: Setenta kilómetros al oeste, ya en Basilicata, una hora. Los sassi son viviendas excavadas en el barranco, habitadas hasta los años cincuenta y hoy hoteles. A muchos solo se llega a pie por escaleras: dinos el nombre y buscamos la calle más cercana.

pt.name: Matera
pt.about: Setenta quilómetros para oeste, já na Basilicata, uma hora. Os sassi são habitações escavadas na ravina, habitadas até aos anos cinquenta e hoje hotéis. A muitos só se chega a pé por escadas: diga-nos o nome e procuramos a rua mais próxima.

fr.name: Matera
fr.about: Soixante-dix kilomètres à l'ouest, en Basilicate, une heure. Les sassi sont des habitations creusées dans le ravin, habitées jusqu'aux années cinquante et aujourd'hui des hôtels. Beaucoup ne s'atteignent qu'à pied par des escaliers.

destinations.name: Monopoli
destinations.about: Fifty-five kilometres south, forty-five minutes. A fishing port with a walled centre and a harbour full of blue wooden boats. Quieter than Polignano and, most people think, better for it.

es.name: Monopoli
es.about: Cincuenta y cinco kilómetros al sur, cuarenta y cinco minutos. Un puerto pesquero con centro amurallado y una dársena llena de barcas azules de madera. Más tranquilo que Polignano y, para casi todos, mejor por eso.

pt.name: Monopoli
pt.about: Cinquenta e cinco quilómetros para sul, quarenta e cinco minutos. Um porto de pesca com centro muralhado e uma doca cheia de barcos azuis de madeira. Mais calmo do que Polignano e, para quase todos, melhor por isso.

fr.name: Monopoli
fr.about: Cinquante-cinq kilomètres au sud, quarante-cinq minutes. Un port de pêche au centre fortifié et un bassin plein de barques bleues en bois. Plus calme que Polignano, et meilleur pour cela.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Bari
es.about: Bari Karol Wojtyła is nine kilometres from the city and connected by a train that runs to the central station in fourteen minutes. Puglia spreads out from here — the trulli, the coast, and Matera an hour inland.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Bari
pt.about: Bari Karol Wojtyła is nine kilometres from the city and connected by a train that runs to the central station in fourteen minutes. Puglia spreads out from here — the trulli, the coast, and Matera an hour inland.

fr.name: Aéroport de Bari
fr.about: Bari Karol Wojtyła is nine kilometres from the city and connected by a train that runs to the central station in fourteen minutes. Puglia spreads out from here — the trulli, the coast, and Matera an hour inland.

airports.name: Turin Airport
airports.about: Caselle is seventeen kilometres north of Turin, the first capital of Italy and the home of Fiat. The Alps are visible from the terminal on a clear day, and the ski resorts are ninety minutes west.
tips: Seventeen kilometres to the centre, twenty-five minutes.
The ski resorts of the Via Lattea are 100 to 110 kilometres west.
Turin's centre is arcaded and laid out on a Roman grid — easy to navigate, hard to park in.
local: The mountains are close
Sestriere is a hundred and ten kilometres, Bardonecchia a hundred and five. Both are under two hours, and in winter the transfer beats the train because of the ski gear.
Where Italian food comes from
Alba for the truffles, Barolo for the wine, Bra for the Slow Food movement. All within ninety kilometres, all better with a driver.
A capital that stopped being one
Turin was the capital until 1865 and the buildings still look the part. The centre is grand, quiet and much less visited than it deserves.
compare: Dora is not central. A second journey for most hotels.
Slow in traffic. Two stops only.
No fixed fare. Evening supplements apply.

destinations.name: Turin city centre
