destinations.about: Seventeen kilometres south, twenty-five minutes. Turin is arcaded — eighteen kilometres of covered walkways — and laid out on a Roman grid, so an address is easy to find. The centre has a limited-traffic zone and our vehicles are cleared.

es.name: Centro de Turín
es.about: Diecisiete kilómetros al sur, veinticinco minutos. Turín tiene dieciocho kilómetros de soportales y una trama romana, así que encontrar una dirección es fácil. El centro tiene zona de tráfico limitado y nuestros vehículos están autorizados.

pt.name: Centro de Turim
pt.about: Dezassete quilómetros para sul, vinte e cinco minutos. Turim tem dezoito quilómetros de arcadas e uma malha romana, por isso encontrar uma morada é fácil. O centro tem zona de trânsito limitado e os nossos veículos estão autorizados.

fr.name: Centre de Turin
fr.about: Dix-sept kilomètres au sud, vingt-cinq minutes. Turin compte dix-huit kilomètres d'arcades et un plan romain : trouver une adresse est simple. Le centre est en zone à trafic limité et nos véhicules y sont autorisés.

destinations.name: Sestriere
destinations.about: A hundred and ten kilometres west into the Alps, an hour and forty. In winter the last stretch needs chains and the driver carries them. Ski gear travels better in a car than on a train with two changes.

es.name: Sestriere
es.about: Ciento diez kilómetros al oeste, hacia los Alpes, una hora y cuarenta. En invierno el último tramo pide cadenas y el conductor las lleva. El material de esquí viaja mejor en coche que en un tren con dos transbordos.

pt.name: Sestriere
pt.about: Cento e dez quilómetros para oeste, para os Alpes, uma hora e quarenta. No inverno o último troço pede correntes e o motorista leva-as. O equipamento de esqui viaja melhor de carro do que num comboio com dois transbordos.

fr.name: Sestrières
fr.about: Cent dix kilomètres à l'ouest, vers les Alpes, une heure quarante. En hiver le dernier tronçon exige des chaînes et le chauffeur en a. Le matériel de ski voyage mieux en voiture qu'en train avec deux correspondances.

destinations.name: Bardonecchia
destinations.about: A hundred and five kilometres west, an hour and a half up the Susa valley. Bardonecchia is the last town before the French border and the tunnel to Modane. Snow is normal from December to March.

es.name: Bardonecchia
es.about: Ciento cinco kilómetros al oeste, hora y media subiendo el valle de Susa. Bardonecchia es el último pueblo antes de la frontera francesa y del túnel a Modane. La nieve es normal de diciembre a marzo.

pt.name: Bardonecchia
pt.about: Cento e cinco quilómetros para oeste, hora e meia a subir o vale de Susa. Bardonecchia é a última vila antes da fronteira francesa e do túnel para Modane. A neve é normal de dezembro a março.

fr.name: Bardonecchia
fr.about: Cent cinq kilomètres à l'ouest, une heure et demie en remontant la vallée de Suse. Bardonecchia est le dernier village avant la frontière et le tunnel de Modane. La neige y est normale de décembre à mars.

destinations.name: Asti
destinations.about: Seventy-five kilometres south-east, an hour. Asti is the sparkling wine and the September palio, run bareback around the main square. The Monferrato hills start here and are a UNESCO landscape.

es.name: Asti
es.about: Setenta y cinco kilómetros al sureste, una hora. Asti es el espumoso y el palio de septiembre, que se corre a pelo por la plaza mayor. Las colinas del Monferrato empiezan aquí y son Patrimonio de la Humanidad.

pt.name: Asti
pt.about: Setenta e cinco quilómetros para sudeste, uma hora. Asti é o espumante e o palio de setembro, corrido em pelo à volta da praça principal. As colinas do Monferrato começam aqui e são Património Mundial.

fr.name: Asti
fr.about: Soixante-quinze kilomètres au sud-est, une heure. Asti, c'est le mousseux et le palio de septembre, couru à cru autour de la grand-place. Les collines du Monferrato commencent ici et sont classées.

destinations.name: Alba
destinations.about: Eighty-five kilometres south, an hour and ten. Alba is white truffles in autumn and Barolo all year. The road through the Langhe hills is slow and worth taking slowly.

es.name: Alba
es.about: Ochenta y cinco kilómetros al sur, una hora y diez. Alba es trufa blanca en otoño y Barolo todo el año. La carretera por las colinas de las Langhe es lenta y merece tomarse con calma.

pt.name: Alba
pt.about: Oitenta e cinco quilómetros para sul, uma hora e dez. Alba é trufa branca no outono e Barolo o ano todo. A estrada pelas colinas das Langhe é lenta e merece ser feita com calma.

fr.name: Alba
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-cinq kilomètres au sud, une heure dix. Alba, c'est la truffe blanche en automne et le barolo toute l'année. La route à travers les Langhe est lente et mérite qu'on prenne son temps.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Turín
es.about: Caselle is seventeen kilometres north of Turin, the first capital of Italy and the home of Fiat. The Alps are visible from the terminal on a clear day, and the ski resorts are ninety minutes west.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Turim
pt.about: Caselle is seventeen kilometres north of Turin, the first capital of Italy and the home of Fiat. The Alps are visible from the terminal on a clear day, and the ski resorts are ninety minutes west.

fr.name: Aéroport de Turin
fr.about: Caselle is seventeen kilometres north of Turin, the first capital of Italy and the home of Fiat. The Alps are visible from the terminal on a clear day, and the ski resorts are ninety minutes west.

airports.name: Florence Airport
airports.about: Peretola is six kilometres from the Duomo, which makes it one of the closest city airports in Italy. It is also small, with a single runway that closes in strong crosswinds — diversions to Pisa or Bologna happen a few times a year.
tips: Six kilometres to the centre. Fifteen minutes, twenty-five if the Viale is busy.
The tram line T2 runs to Santa Maria Novella in twenty minutes for €1.50. It works well if you travel light.
In fog or high wind the airport diverts to Pisa. If that happens, tell us — we move the pick-up rather than charge you twice.
local: The ZTL, and why it matters more here
Florence's limited-traffic zone covers most of the historic centre and the cameras are unforgiving. Our vehicles are authorised. A hire car is not, and the fine arrives by post six months later.
A small airport that diverts

One runway, and it points the wrong way for the prevailing wind. Diversions to Pisa are not common but they are not rare either. We track the flight, so a diversion means we meet you where you actually land.
Tuscany starts at the door
Siena is seventy kilometres, San Gimignano fifty, Chianti begins twenty minutes out. For a day in the hills an hourly booking works better than two transfers — you keep the car and the driver waits.
compare: Cheap, frequent, and it avoids the traffic.
One bag each in practice. Standing room only at peak times.
Short trip, so the meter stays low.
Queues after each arrival wave. Supplements for bags and evenings.
The ZTL cameras. Parking in Florence costs €30 a day and is hard to find.

destinations.name: Florence city centre
destinations.about: Six kilometres, fifteen minutes. The centre is a limited-traffic zone with camera enforcement and our vehicles are registered to enter. Give the street and number — many hotels are on streets a car cannot turn into, and the driver needs to know where to stop.

es.name: Centro de Florencia
es.about: Seis kilómetros, quince minutos. El centro es zona de tráfico limitado con cámaras, y nuestros vehículos están autorizados a entrar.

pt.name: Centro de Florença
pt.about: Seis quilómetros, quinze minutos. O centro é zona de trânsito limitado com câmaras, e os nossos veículos estão autorizados a entrar.

fr.name: Centre de Florence
fr.about: Six kilomètres, quinze minutes. Le centre est une zone à trafic limité sous caméras, et nos véhicules sont autorisés à y entrer.

destinations.name: Fiesole
destinations.about: Eleven kilometres, but twenty-five minutes — the road climbs sharply and turns constantly. Fiesole looks down on Florence from three hundred metres up, and the view at sunset is the reason most people go.

es.name: Fiesole
es.about: Once kilómetros, pero veinticinco minutos: la carretera sube con fuerza y no deja de girar. Fiesole mira a Florencia desde trescientos metros de altura.

pt.name: Fiesole
pt.about: Onze quilómetros, mas vinte e cinco minutos — a estrada sobe muito e não para de curvar. Fiesole olha Florença de trezentos metros de altura.

fr.name: Fiesole
fr.about: Onze kilomètres, mais vingt-cinq minutes : la route grimpe fort et tourne sans cesse. Fiesole domine Florence de trois cents mètres.

destinations.name: Siena
destinations.about: Seventy-two kilometres south through Chianti, an hour and ten. The old town is closed to traffic and built on three ridges — the drop-off point matters, because the walk from the wrong gate to the Campo is steep and long.

es.name: Siena
es.about: Setenta y dos kilómetros al sur por el Chianti, una hora y diez. El casco antiguo está cerrado al tráfico y construido sobre tres colinas.

pt.name: Siena
pt.about: Setenta e dois quilómetros para sul pelo Chianti, uma hora e dez. O centro antigo está fechado ao trânsito e construído sobre três colinas.

fr.name: Sienne
fr.about: Soixante-douze kilomètres au sud par le Chianti, une heure dix. La vieille ville est fermée à la circulation et bâtie sur trois collines.

destinations.name: Pisa
destinations.about: Eighty-six kilometres west, an hour and a quarter. Pisa has its own airport, and if your onward flight leaves from there this transfer is the usual way across. The tower and the cathedral are in one square, twenty minutes from the station.

es.name: Pisa
es.about: Ochenta y seis kilómetros al oeste, hora y cuarto. Pisa tiene aeropuerto propio, y si tu vuelo de salida sale de allí este traslado es el camino habitual.

pt.name: Pisa
pt.about: Oitenta e seis quilómetros para oeste, hora e um quarto. Pisa tem aeroporto próprio, e se o seu voo seguinte parte de lá este transfer é o caminho habitual.

fr.name: Pise
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-six kilomètres à l'ouest, une heure et quart. Pise a son propre aéroport, et si votre vol de départ part de là, ce transfert est le trajet habituel.

destinations.name: Lucca
destinations.about: Seventy-eight kilometres north-west, an hour and ten. Lucca is walled and the walls are intact — you can cycle the whole circuit. Cars stop outside the gates, which is a short walk from anywhere inside.

es.name: Lucca
es.about: Setenta y ocho kilómetros al noroeste, una hora y diez. Lucca está amurallada y las murallas siguen enteras: se pueden recorrer en bici.

pt.name: Lucca
pt.about: Setenta e oito quilómetros para noroeste, uma hora e dez. Lucca é murada e as muralhas estão inteiras: dá para as percorrer de bicicleta.

fr.name: Lucques
fr.about: Soixante-dix-huit kilomètres au nord-ouest, une heure dix. Lucques est fortifiée et ses remparts sont intacts : on peut en faire le tour à vélo.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Florencia
es.about: Peretola está a seis kilómetros del Duomo, uno de los aeropuertos urbanos más cercanos de Italia. También es pequeño, con una sola pista.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Florença
pt.about: Peretola fica a seis quilómetros do Duomo, um dos aeroportos urbanos mais próximos de Itália. É também pequeno, com uma só pista.

fr.name: Aéroport de Florence
fr.about: Peretola est à six kilomètres du Duomo, l'un des aéroports urbains les plus proches d'Italie. Il est aussi petit, avec une seule piste.

airports.name: Verona Airport
airports.about: Villafranca is twelve kilometres from Verona and twenty from the southern shore of Lake Garda. In opera season the city fills for two months and the airport with it.
tips: Twelve kilometres to the centre, twenty minutes.
Lake Garda begins at Peschiera, twenty-five kilometres west.
The Arena opera season runs from June to September and performances end near midnight.
local: Opera nights end late
The Arena programme finishes between 23:30 and 00:30. The last trains to most lake towns have gone. A booked car waiting is the difference between staying in Verona and going back to your hotel.
Lake Garda's south shore
Sirmione, Peschiera and Lazise are all within thirty-five kilometres. The road along the lake is slow in July but the drive from the airport is on the motorway most of the way.
A compact centre
Verona fits inside a bend of the Adige and you can cross it on foot in twenty minutes. The ZTL covers most of it; our vehicles are cleared.
compare: Station only. Bags in the hold.
Queues after arrivals, and long ones on opera nights.
The Verona ZTL. Parking near the Arena is scarce and expensive.

destinations.name: Verona city centre
destinations.about: Twelve kilometres, twenty minutes. Verona fits inside a bend of the Adige and you cross it on foot in twenty minutes. The ZTL covers most of the centre; our vehicles are registered to enter it.

es.name: Centro de Verona
es.about: Doce kilómetros, veinte minutos. Verona cabe dentro de un meandro del Adigio y se cruza a pie en veinte minutos. La ZTL cubre casi todo el centro y nuestros vehículos están registrados para entrar.

pt.name: Centro de Verona
pt.about: Doze quilómetros, vinte minutos. Verona cabe dentro de um meandro do Ádige e atravessa-se a pé em vinte minutos. A ZTL cobre quase todo o centro e os nossos veículos estão registados para entrar.

fr.name: Centre de Vérone
fr.about: Douze kilomètres, vingt minutes. Vérone tient dans une boucle de l'Adige et se traverse à pied en vingt minutes. La ZTL couvre presque tout le centre et nos véhicules sont enregistrés pour y entrer.

destinations.name: Sirmione
destinations.about: Thirty-five kilometres west, thirty-five minutes. Sirmione is on a spit of land reaching into Lake Garda, and the old town at the end is closed to traffic. The drop-off is at the castle bridge.

es.name: Sirmione
es.about: Treinta y cinco kilómetros al oeste, treinta y cinco minutos. Sirmione está en una lengua de tierra que entra en el lago de Garda, y el casco antiguo del final está cerrado al tráfico. La parada es en el puente del castillo.

pt.name: Sirmione
pt.about: Trinta e cinco quilómetros para oeste, trinta e cinco minutos. Sirmione fica numa língua de terra que entra no lago de Garda, e o centro velho no fim está fechado ao trânsito. A paragem é na ponte do castelo.

fr.name: Sirmione
fr.about: Trente-cinq kilomètres à l'ouest, trente-cinq minutes. Sirmione occupe une langue de terre qui avance dans le lac de Garde, et la vieille ville au bout est fermée à la circulation. La dépose se fait au pont du château.

destinations.name: Lake Garda
destinations.about: Thirty kilometres to the southern shore, thirty-five minutes. Peschiera, Lazise and Bardolino are strung along it within fifteen kilometres of each other. Tell us the town rather than the lake.

es.name: Lago de Garda
es.about: Treinta kilómetros hasta la orilla sur, treinta y cinco minutos. Peschiera, Lazise y Bardolino se suceden en quince kilómetros. Dinos el pueblo, no el lago.

pt.name: Lago de Garda
pt.about: Trinta quilómetros até à margem sul, trinta e cinco minutos. Peschiera, Lazise e Bardolino sucedem-se em quinze quilómetros. Diga-nos a vila, não o lago.

fr.name: Lac de Garde
fr.about: Trente kilomètres jusqu'à la rive sud, trente-cinq minutes. Peschiera, Lazise et Bardolino se succèdent sur quinze kilomètres. Donnez-nous le village, pas le lac.

destinations.name: Vicenza
destinations.about: Fifty-five kilometres east, forty-five minutes. Palladio built twenty-three buildings here and the whole centre is his. The Teatro Olimpico is the oldest indoor theatre in the world and still in use.

es.name: Vicenza
es.about: Cincuenta y cinco kilómetros al este, cuarenta y cinco minutos. Palladio construyó aquí veintitrés edificios y el centro entero es suyo. El Teatro Olímpico es el teatro cubierto más antiguo del mundo y sigue en uso.

pt.name: Vicenza
pt.about: Cinquenta e cinco quilómetros para leste, quarenta e cinco minutos. Palladio construiu aqui vinte e três edifícios e o centro inteiro é dele. O Teatro Olímpico é o teatro coberto mais antigo do mundo e continua em uso.

fr.name: Vicence
fr.about: Cinquante-cinq kilomètres à l'est, quarante-cinq minutes. Palladio y a bâti vingt-trois édifices et tout le centre est de lui. Le Teatro Olimpico est le plus ancien théâtre couvert du monde, toujours en activité.

destinations.name: Trento
destinations.about: Ninety-five kilometres north up the Adige valley, an hour and a quarter. The motorway follows the river the whole way, between mountains. Trento is where Italy starts feeling Austrian.

es.name: Trento
es.about: Noventa y cinco kilómetros al norte por el valle del Adigio, hora y cuarto. La autopista sigue el río todo el camino, entre montañas. En Trento Italia empieza a parecer austriaca.

pt.name: Trento
pt.about: Noventa e cinco quilómetros para norte pelo vale do Ádige, hora e um quarto. A autoestrada segue o rio todo o caminho, entre montanhas. Em Trento a Itália começa a parecer austríaca.

fr.name: Trente
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-quinze kilomètres au nord par la vallée de l'Adige, une heure et quart. L'autoroute suit la rivière entre les montagnes. À Trente, l'Italie commence à ressembler à l'Autriche.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Verona
es.about: Villafranca is twelve kilometres from Verona and twenty from the southern shore of Lake Garda. In opera season the city fills for two months and the airport with it.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Verona
pt.about: Villafranca is twelve kilometres from Verona and twenty from the southern shore of Lake Garda. In opera season the city fills for two months and the airport with it.

fr.name: Aéroport de Vérone
fr.about: Villafranca is twelve kilometres from Verona and twenty from the southern shore of Lake Garda. In opera season the city fills for two months and the airport with it.

airports.name: Brindisi Airport
airports.about: Brindisi Salento is six kilometres from the city and the gateway to the Salento — the heel of Italy, with beaches on both coasts and baroque Lecce forty-five kilometres inland.
tips: Six kilometres to Brindisi, twelve minutes.
Lecce is forty-five kilometres south, forty minutes.
Brindisi is a ferry port for Greece and Albania.
local: The heel has two coasts
The Adriatic side has the cliffs and the sea caves; the Ionian has the sand. Neither is more than fifty kilometres from the airport and both are worth a day.
Lecce
Forty-five kilometres, and the reason most people fly here. Baroque carved into soft limestone, a Roman amphitheatre in the main square, and a centre small enough to walk.
The masserie
Fortified farmhouses converted into hotels, scattered across the countryside between Brindisi and Ostuni. Most are down unmarked tracks — send us the coordinates rather than the address.
compare: Timed to some flights. Station only.
No fixed fare, and it is a long enough run for that to add up.

destinations.name: Brindisi city centre
destinations.about: Six kilometres, twelve minutes. Brindisi is where the Appian Way ended and the column marking it still stands above the harbour. The port is a kilometre from the centre.

es.name: Centro de Brindisi
es.about: Seis kilómetros, doce minutos. Brindisi es donde acababa la Vía Apia y la columna que lo marca sigue en pie sobre el puerto. El puerto está a un kilómetro del centro.

pt.name: Centro de Brindisi
pt.about: Seis quilómetros, doze minutos. Brindisi é onde acabava a Via Ápia e a coluna que o marca continua de pé sobre o porto. O porto fica a um quilómetro do centro.

fr.name: Centre de Brindisi
fr.about: Six kilomètres, douze minutes. Brindisi est là où finissait la Voie Appienne et la colonne qui le marque tient toujours au-dessus du port.

destinations.name: Lecce
destinations.about: Forty-five kilometres south, forty minutes. Lecce is baroque carved into soft limestone, with a Roman amphitheatre in the main square. The centre is walled and small enough to cross on foot.

es.name: Lecce
es.about: Cuarenta y cinco kilómetros al sur, cuarenta minutos. Lecce es barroco tallado en piedra blanda, con un anfiteatro romano en la plaza mayor. El centro está amurallado y es lo bastante pequeño para cruzarlo a pie.

pt.name: Lecce
pt.about: Quarenta e cinco quilómetros para sul, quarenta minutos. Lecce é barroco esculpido em pedra macia, com um anfiteatro romano na praça principal. O centro é murado e pequeno o suficiente para se atravessar a pé.

fr.name: Lecce
fr.about: Quarante-cinq kilomètres au sud, quarante minutes. Lecce, c'est du baroque taillé dans une pierre tendre, avec un amphithéâtre romain sur la grand-place. Le centre est fortifié et se traverse à pied.

destinations.name: Ostuni
destinations.about: Forty kilometres north-west, forty minutes. The white town on a hill, visible from twenty kilometres away. The centre is a spiral of whitewashed alleys and cars stop at the bottom.

es.name: Ostuni
es.about: Cuarenta kilómetros al noroeste, cuarenta minutos. El pueblo blanco en la colina, visible desde veinte kilómetros. El centro es una espiral de callejones encalados y los coches paran abajo.

pt.name: Ostuni
pt.about: Quarenta quilómetros para noroeste, quarenta minutos. A vila branca na colina, visível a vinte quilómetros. O centro é uma espiral de vielas caiadas e os carros param em baixo.

fr.name: Ostuni
fr.about: Quarante kilomètres au nord-ouest, quarante minutes. Le village blanc sur sa colline, visible à vingt kilomètres. Le centre est une spirale de ruelles chaulées et les voitures s'arrêtent en bas.

destinations.name: Otranto
destinations.about: Eighty-five kilometres south-east, an hour and ten. The easternmost town in Italy, with a cathedral floor covered in a twelfth-century mosaic of the tree of life. Albania is visible on a clear day.

es.name: Otranto
es.about: Ochenta y cinco kilómetros al sureste, una hora y diez. El pueblo más oriental de Italia, con un suelo de catedral cubierto por un mosaico del siglo XII del árbol de la vida. Albania se ve en día claro.

pt.name: Otranto
pt.about: Oitenta e cinco quilómetros para sudeste, uma hora e dez. A vila mais oriental de Itália, com um chão de catedral coberto por um mosaico do século XII da árvore da vida. A Albânia vê-se em dia claro.

fr.name: Otrante
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-cinq kilomètres au sud-est, une heure dix. La ville la plus orientale d'Italie, avec un sol de cathédrale couvert d'une mosaïque du XIIe siècle représentant l'arbre de vie.

destinations.name: Gallipoli
destinations.about: Ninety-five kilometres south-west, an hour and twenty, and you cross the heel to the Ionian side. The old town is on an island joined by a bridge, and the beaches south of it are the best in Puglia.

es.name: Gallipoli
es.about: Noventa y cinco kilómetros al suroeste, una hora y veinte, cruzando el tacón hasta el lado jónico. El casco antiguo está en una isla unida por un puente, y las playas del sur son las mejores de Apulia.

pt.name: Gallipoli
pt.about: Noventa e cinco quilómetros para sudoeste, uma hora e vinte, a atravessar o salto até ao lado jónico. O centro velho fica numa ilha ligada por uma ponte, e as praias a sul são as melhores da Puglia.

fr.name: Gallipoli
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-quinze kilomètres au sud-ouest, une heure vingt, en traversant le talon jusqu'au versant ionien. La vieille ville est sur une île reliée par un pont, et les plages au sud sont les plus belles des Pouilles.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Brindisi
es.about: Brindisi Salento is six kilometres from the city and the gateway to the Salento — the heel of Italy, with beaches on both coasts and baroque Lecce forty-five kilometres inland.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Brindisi
pt.about: Brindisi Salento is six kilometres from the city and the gateway to the Salento — the heel of Italy, with beaches on both coasts and baroque Lecce forty-five kilometres inland.

fr.name: Aéroport de Brindisi
fr.about: Brindisi Salento is six kilometres from the city and the gateway to the Salento — the heel of Italy, with beaches on both coasts and baroque Lecce forty-five kilometres inland.

airports.name: Lamezia Terme Airport
airports.about: Lamezia Terme sits on the narrowest part of Calabria, six kilometres from the town and with both coasts within forty kilometres. It is the main airport for the Calabrian beaches and the transfer times are short.
tips: Six kilometres to Lamezia, twelve minutes.
Tropea is sixty kilometres south-west, about an hour.
Both coasts are within forty kilometres — Calabria narrows to thirty here.
local: Both coasts in forty kilometres
Calabria narrows to thirty kilometres here. The Tyrrhenian side has the cliffs and the sunsets; the Ionian has the flatter beaches and fewer people.
Tropea
Sixty kilometres, an hour on a road that improves near the coast. The town sits on a cliff above a beach that appears on every list of Italy's best.
The Sila and the Aspromonte
Mountains at 1,900 metres, an hour inland, with snow in winter. Almost nobody who comes for the beaches knows they are there.
compare: Hourly. Centrale is not near the beaches.
Few taxis. To Tropea the meter runs and it is expensive.
Mountain roads are slow. Coastal parking is scarce in August.

destinations.name: Lamezia Terme
destinations.about: Six kilometres, twelve minutes. Lamezia Terme is three towns joined into one in 1968 and the centre is modern. Most people pass through on the way to the coast.

es.name: Lamezia Terme
es.about: Seis kilómetros, doce minutos. Lamezia Terme son tres pueblos unidos en 1968 y el centro es moderno. Casi todo el mundo pasa de camino a la costa.

pt.name: Lamezia Terme
pt.about: Seis quilómetros, doze minutos. Lamezia Terme são três vilas juntadas em 1968 e o centro é moderno. Quase toda a gente passa a caminho da costa.

fr.name: Lamezia Terme
fr.about: Six kilomètres, douze minutes. Lamezia Terme, ce sont trois villages réunis en 1968 et le centre est moderne. Presque tout le monde ne fait que passer vers la côte.

destinations.name: Tropea
destinations.about: Sixty kilometres south-west, an hour. The road improves as it nears the coast. Tropea is on a cliff above a beach that appears on every list of Italy's best, and the town is closed to traffic.

es.name: Tropea
es.about: Sesenta kilómetros al suroeste, una hora. La carretera mejora al acercarse a la costa. Tropea está sobre un acantilado encima de una playa que sale en todas las listas de las mejores de Italia, y el pueblo está cerrado al tráfico.

pt.name: Tropea
pt.about: Sessenta quilómetros para sudoeste, uma hora. A estrada melhora ao aproximar-se da costa. Tropea fica sobre uma falésia por cima de uma praia que aparece em todas as listas das melhores de Itália, e a vila está fechada ao trânsito.

fr.name: Tropea
fr.about: Soixante kilomètres au sud-ouest, une heure. La route s'améliore en approchant de la côte. Tropea est perchée sur une falaise au-dessus d'une plage citée dans toutes les listes des plus belles d'Italie.

destinations.name: Pizzo
destinations.about: Thirty-five kilometres south, thirty-five minutes. Pizzo is where tartufo ice cream was invented and the church carved into the sea cave is worth the stop on the way past.

es.name: Pizzo
es.about: Treinta y cinco kilómetros al sur, treinta y cinco minutos. En Pizzo se inventó el tartufo de helado, y la iglesia excavada en la cueva marina merece la parada de camino.

pt.name: Pizzo
pt.about: Trinta e cinco quilómetros para sul, trinta e cinco minutos. Em Pizzo inventou-se o tartufo de gelado, e a igreja escavada na gruta marinha merece a paragem de caminho.

fr.name: Pizzo
fr.about: Trente-cinq kilomètres au sud, trente-cinq minutes. C'est à Pizzo qu'on a inventé le tartufo glacé, et l'église creusée dans la grotte marine mérite l'arrêt en chemin.

destinations.name: Catanzaro
destinations.about: Forty kilometres east, forty minutes, and you cross Calabria at its narrowest. Catanzaro is the regional capital, on a ridge between two gorges, joined by one of the highest bridges in Europe.

es.name: Catanzaro
es.about: Cuarenta kilómetros al este, cuarenta minutos, y cruzas Calabria por su parte más estrecha. Catanzaro es la capital regional, sobre una cresta entre dos barrancos, unidos por uno de los puentes más altos de Europa.

pt.name: Catanzaro
pt.about: Quarenta quilómetros para leste, quarenta minutos, e atravessa-se a Calábria na parte mais estreita. Catanzaro é a capital regional, sobre uma crista entre duas ravinas, ligadas por uma das pontes mais altas da Europa.

fr.name: Catanzaro
fr.about: Quarante kilomètres à l'est, quarante minutes, et l'on traverse la Calabre en son point le plus étroit. Catanzaro est la capitale régionale, sur une crête entre deux ravins reliés par l'un des plus hauts ponts d'Europe.

destinations.name: Capo Vaticano
destinations.about: Seventy-five kilometres south-west, an hour and a quarter. A headland of granite and small coves past Tropea. The road down to each beach is steep and narrow, and some end in steps.

es.name: Capo Vaticano
es.about: Setenta y cinco kilómetros al suroeste, hora y cuarto. Un cabo de granito con calas pequeñas pasado Tropea. La bajada a cada playa es empinada y estrecha, y alguna acaba en escaleras.

pt.name: Capo Vaticano
pt.about: Setenta e cinco quilómetros para sudoeste, hora e um quarto. Um cabo de granito com enseadas pequenas passado Tropea. A descida a cada praia é íngreme e estreita, e algumas acabam em escadas.

fr.name: Capo Vaticano
fr.about: Soixante-quinze kilomètres au sud-ouest, une heure et quart. Un cap de granit avec de petites criques après Tropea. La descente vers chaque plage est raide et étroite, et certaines finissent en escaliers.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Lamezia Terme
es.about: Lamezia Terme sits on the narrowest part of Calabria, six kilometres from the town and with both coasts within forty kilometres. It is the main airport for the Calabrian beaches and the transfer times are short.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Lamezia Terme
pt.about: Lamezia Terme sits on the narrowest part of Calabria, six kilometres from the town and with both coasts within forty kilometres. It is the main airport for the Calabrian beaches and the transfer times are short.

fr.name: Aéroport de Lamezia Terme
fr.about: Lamezia Terme sits on the narrowest part of Calabria, six kilometres from the town and with both coasts within forty kilometres. It is the main airport for the Calabrian beaches and the transfer times are short.

airports.name: Treviso Airport
airports.about: Canova is five kilometres from Treviso and forty from Venice. It is the low-cost alternative to Marco Polo, and the bus to Venice is scheduled around the flight arrivals.
tips: Forty kilometres to Venice Piazzale Roma, forty-five minutes.
Treviso itself is five kilometres and worth an evening — walled, canalled and almost empty of tourists.
The airport is small and closes overnight. Late arrivals find nothing open.
local: The other Venice airport
Forty kilometres against thirteen from Marco Polo. The fares are lower and the transfer costs more; whether that adds up depends on how many of you there are.
Treviso is not a suburb
A walled town with canals and frescoed houses, and the birthplace of tiramisu. Most people pass through it without stopping, which is their loss.
The Prosecco hills
Valdobbiadene and Conegliano are forty kilometres north, and the road between them is a UNESCO landscape. Better with a driver, for obvious reasons.
compare: Only when there is a flight. Seventy minutes, and bags in the hold.
Station only. Small bus, little luggage room.
No fixed fare. Expensive for a single traveller.

destinations.name: Treviso city centre
destinations.about: Five kilometres, twelve minutes. Treviso is walled, crossed by canals, and the birthplace of tiramisu. Most people pass through on the way to Venice without stopping, which is their loss.

es.name: Centro de Treviso
es.about: Cinco kilómetros, doce minutos. Treviso está amurallada, cruzada por canales, y es la cuna del tiramisú. Casi todos pasan de largo camino de Venecia, y se lo pierden.

pt.name: Centro de Treviso
pt.about: Cinco quilómetros, doze minutos. Treviso é murada, atravessada por canais, e é o berço do tiramisu. Quase toda a gente passa ao lado a caminho de Veneza, e perde.

fr.name: Centre de Trévise
fr.about: Cinq kilomètres, douze minutes. Trévise est fortifiée, traversée de canaux, et c'est le berceau du tiramisu. Presque tous passent sans s'arrêter en allant à Venise, et ils ont tort.

destinations.name: Venice Piazzale Roma
destinations.about: Forty kilometres south, forty-five minutes to Piazzale Roma. That is where every land vehicle stops — from there it is a vaporetto or a walk over bridges, and how far depends on your hotel.

es.name: Venecia Piazzale Roma
es.about: Cuarenta kilómetros al sur, cuarenta y cinco minutos hasta Piazzale Roma. Allí paran todos los vehículos por carretera: desde ahí es vaporetto o andar sobre puentes, y cuánto depende de tu hotel.

pt.name: Veneza Piazzale Roma
pt.about: Quarenta quilómetros para sul, quarenta e cinco minutos até Piazzale Roma. Aí param todos os veículos de estrada: dali é vaporetto ou andar sobre pontes, e quanto depende do seu hotel.

fr.name: Venise Piazzale Roma
fr.about: Quarante kilomètres au sud, quarante-cinq minutes jusqu'à Piazzale Roma. Tous les véhicules routiers s'y arrêtent : ensuite c'est le vaporetto ou la marche sur les ponts, selon votre hôtel.

destinations.name: Padua
destinations.about: Sixty kilometres south-west, fifty-five minutes. Padua has the Scrovegni Chapel, frescoed by Giotto, and a university where Galileo taught. Booking for the chapel is compulsory and the slots are short.

es.name: Padua
es.about: Sesenta kilómetros al suroeste, cincuenta y cinco minutos. Padua tiene la Capilla de los Scrovegni, con frescos de Giotto, y una universidad donde enseñó Galileo. Para la capilla hay que reservar y los turnos son cortos.

pt.name: Pádua
pt.about: Sessenta quilómetros para sudoeste, cinquenta e cinco minutos. Pádua tem a Capela dos Scrovegni, com frescos de Giotto, e uma universidade onde Galileu ensinou. Para a capela é preciso reservar e os turnos são curtos.

fr.name: Padoue
fr.about: Soixante kilomètres au sud-ouest, cinquante-cinq minutes. Padoue possède la chapelle des Scrovegni, peinte par Giotto, et une université où Galilée a enseigné. La chapelle se réserve et les créneaux sont courts.

destinations.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
destinations.about: A hundred and thirty kilometres north into the Dolomites, an hour and fifty. The last forty kilometres climb through the mountains. Cortina hosts the 2026 Winter Olympics, and the road up will be busy for it.

es.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
es.about: Ciento treinta kilómetros al norte, hacia los Dolomitas, una hora y cincuenta. Los últimos cuarenta suben entre montañas. Cortina acoge los Juegos de Invierno de 2026 y la carretera estará cargada por ello.

pt.name: Cortina d’Ampezzo
pt.about: Cento e trinta quilómetros para norte, para os Dolomitas, uma hora e cinquenta. Os últimos quarenta sobem por entre montanhas. Cortina recebe os Jogos de Inverno de 2026 e a estrada vai estar carregada por isso.

fr.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
fr.about: Cent trente kilomètres au nord, vers les Dolomites, une heure cinquante. Les quarante derniers montent entre les montagnes. Cortina accueille les Jeux d'hiver 2026 et la route en sera chargée.

destinations.name: Asolo
destinations.about: Thirty-five kilometres north-west, thirty-five minutes. A hill town inside its walls, with a castle at the top and views over the Veneto plain. Carlo Scarpa is buried in the cemetery below.

es.name: Asolo
es.about: Treinta y cinco kilómetros al noroeste, treinta y cinco minutos. Un pueblo de colina dentro de sus murallas, con un castillo arriba y vistas sobre la llanura del Véneto. Carlo Scarpa está enterrado en el cementerio de abajo.

pt.name: Asolo
pt.about: Trinta e cinco quilómetros para noroeste, trinta e cinco minutos. Uma vila de colina dentro das suas muralhas, com um castelo no topo e vistas sobre a planície do Vêneto. Carlo Scarpa está enterrado no cemitério abaixo.

fr.name: Asolo
fr.about: Trente-cinq kilomètres au nord-ouest, trente-cinq minutes. Un bourg de colline dans ses remparts, avec un château au sommet et une vue sur la plaine vénitienne. Carlo Scarpa est enterré au cimetière en contrebas.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Treviso
es.about: Canova is five kilometres from Treviso and forty from Venice. It is the low-cost alternative to Marco Polo, and the bus to Venice is scheduled around the flight arrivals.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Treviso
pt.about: Canova is five kilometres from Treviso and forty from Venice. It is the low-cost alternative to Marco Polo, and the bus to Venice is scheduled around the flight arrivals.

fr.name: Aéroport de Trévise
fr.about: Canova is five kilometres from Treviso and forty from Venice. It is the low-cost alternative to Marco Polo, and the bus to Venice is scheduled around the flight arrivals.

airports.name: Genoa Airport
airports.about: Cristoforo Colombo is built on reclaimed land in the harbour, seven kilometres from the centre. Genoa is squeezed between mountains and sea, and the roads reflect it — tunnels, viaducts and very little flat ground.
tips: Seven kilometres to the centre, fifteen minutes.
Portofino is forty kilometres east and the last stretch is narrow.
The old town is the largest medieval centre in Europe and most of it is too narrow for cars.
local: A city on a slope
Genoa runs uphill from the port. Many addresses are reached by lift or funicular rather than road. Tell us the street and we will say where the car can stop.
Portofino, and the road in
Forty kilometres east, but forty-five minutes — the coast road is single-lane in places and busy in summer. Cars are restricted in the village itself.
The Cinque Terre from the west
Ninety-five kilometres, an hour and a half. Most people come from La Spezia, but from Genoa you reach Monterosso first, which is the least crowded of the five.
compare: Two stops. Slow in the tunnels at rush hour.
The old town is unreachable by car; expect to walk the last part.
You have to get to Principe or Brignole first.

destinations.name: Genoa city centre
destinations.about: Seven kilometres along the harbour, fifteen minutes. Genoa climbs steeply from the port and many addresses are reached by lift or funicular rather than by road. Give us the street and we will say where the car can stop.

es.name: Centro de Génova
es.about: Siete kilómetros por el puerto, quince minutos. Génova sube en cuesta desde el mar y a muchas direcciones se llega por ascensor o funicular, no por carretera. Danos la calle y te decimos dónde puede parar el coche.

pt.name: Centro de Génova
pt.about: Sete quilómetros pelo porto, quinze minutos. Génova sobe a pique desde o mar e a muitas moradas chega-se por elevador ou funicular, não por estrada. Dê-nos a rua e dizemos-lhe onde o carro pode parar.

fr.name: Centre de Gênes
fr.about: Sept kilomètres le long du port, quinze minutes. Gênes grimpe depuis la mer et beaucoup d'adresses s'atteignent par ascenseur ou funiculaire, pas par la route. Donnez-nous la rue et nous dirons où la voiture peut s'arrêter.

destinations.name: Portofino
destinations.about: Forty kilometres east, but forty-five minutes — the coast road is single-lane in places and busy from June. Cars cannot enter the village itself; the drop-off is at the car park above it.

es.name: Portofino
es.about: Cuarenta kilómetros al este, pero cuarenta y cinco minutos: la carretera de la costa es de un carril en tramos y va cargada desde junio. Los coches no entran en el pueblo; la parada es en el aparcamiento de arriba.

pt.name: Portofino
pt.about: Quarenta quilómetros para leste, mas quarenta e cinco minutos: a estrada da costa é de uma via em troços e está carregada desde junho. Os carros não entram na vila; a paragem é no parque acima dela.

fr.name: Portofino
fr.about: Quarante kilomètres à l'est, mais quarante-cinq minutes : la route côtière est à une voie par endroits et chargée dès juin. Les voitures n'entrent pas dans le village ; la dépose se fait au parking au-dessus.

destinations.name: Cinque Terre
destinations.about: Ninety-five kilometres south-east, an hour and a half. From this direction you reach Monterosso first, which is the largest of the five and the only one with a proper beach.

es.name: Cinque Terre
es.about: Noventa y cinco kilómetros al sureste, hora y media. Desde este lado se llega primero a Monterosso, el mayor de los cinco y el único con una playa de verdad.

pt.name: Cinque Terre
pt.about: Noventa e cinco quilómetros para sudeste, hora e meia. Deste lado chega-se primeiro a Monterosso, a maior das cinco e a única com uma praia a sério.

fr.name: Cinque Terre
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-quinze kilomètres au sud-est, une heure et demie. De ce côté on atteint d'abord Monterosso, le plus grand des cinq et le seul avec une vraie plage.

destinations.name: Santa Margherita
destinations.about: Thirty-five kilometres east, forty minutes. Santa Margherita is the working town next to Portofino, with the same bay and a fraction of the prices. The ferry to Portofino leaves from here.

es.name: Santa Margherita
es.about: Treinta y cinco kilómetros al este, cuarenta minutos. Santa Margherita es el pueblo de verdad junto a Portofino, con la misma bahía y una fracción de los precios. El barco a Portofino sale de aquí.

pt.name: Santa Margherita
pt.about: Trinta e cinco quilómetros para leste, quarenta minutos. Santa Margherita é a vila a sério ao lado de Portofino, com a mesma baía e uma fração dos preços. O barco para Portofino parte daqui.

fr.name: Santa Margherita
fr.about: Trente-cinq kilomètres à l'est, quarante minutes. Santa Margherita est le vrai village à côté de Portofino, avec la même baie et une fraction des prix. Le bateau pour Portofino part d'ici.

destinations.name: Sanremo
destinations.about: A hundred and forty-five kilometres west along the Riviera, an hour and three quarters. The motorway tunnels most of the way. Sanremo is casinos, flowers and the song festival in February.

es.name: San Remo
es.about: Ciento cuarenta y cinco kilómetros al oeste por la Riviera, una hora y tres cuartos. La autopista va en túnel casi todo el camino. San Remo son casinos, flores y el festival de la canción en febrero.

pt.name: Sanremo
pt.about: Cento e quarenta e cinco quilómetros para oeste pela Riviera, uma hora e três quartos. A autoestrada vai em túnel quase todo o caminho. Sanremo são casinos, flores e o festival da canção em fevereiro.

fr.name: Sanremo
fr.about: Cent quarante-cinq kilomètres à l'ouest le long de la Riviera, une heure trois quarts. L'autoroute est en tunnel presque tout du long. Sanremo, ce sont les casinos, les fleurs et le festival de la chanson en février.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Génova
es.about: Cristoforo Colombo is built on reclaimed land in the harbour, seven kilometres from the centre. Genoa is squeezed between mountains and sea, and the roads reflect it — tunnels, viaducts and very little flat ground.

pt.name: Aeroporto de Génova
pt.about: Cristoforo Colombo is built on reclaimed land in the harbour, seven kilometres from the centre. Genoa is squeezed between mountains and sea, and the roads reflect it — tunnels, viaducts and very little flat ground.

fr.name: Aéroport de Gênes
fr.about: Cristoforo Colombo is built on reclaimed land in the harbour, seven kilometres from the centre. Genoa is squeezed between mountains and sea, and the roads reflect it — tunnels, viaducts and very little flat ground.

airports.name: Trieste Airport
airports.about: Ronchi dei Legionari sits between Trieste and Udine, thirty-three kilometres from each. It serves a corner of Italy that borders Slovenia and Austria, and Ljubljana is closer than Venice.
tips: Thirty-three kilometres to Trieste, thirty-five minutes.
Ljubljana is ninety-five kilometres north-east, about an hour and twenty.
The airport has a train station of its own, which is rare in Italy.
local: Three countries within an hour
Slovenia is twenty kilometres away, Austria a hundred. Ljubljana is closer than Venice and the road is empty. Cross-border transfers are ordinary here.
Trieste is not very Italian
Habsburg architecture, Viennese coffee houses, and a wind called the bora that reaches a hundred kilometres an hour. It belonged to Austria until 1918 and it shows.
Grado and the lagoon
Twenty-five kilometres south, a Roman resort island reached by causeway. Aquileia, with its fourth-century mosaics, is on the way.
compare: Its own station, which is unusual.
Hourly. Trieste Centrale is a walk from the seafront hotels.
No fixed fare, and it is a long enough trip for that to matter.

destinations.name: Trieste city centre
destinations.about: Thirty-three kilometres south, thirty-five minutes. Trieste faces the sea across the largest square in Europe that opens onto water. The Habsburg centre is flat and walkable; the Carso above it is not.

es.name: Centro de Trieste
es.about: Treinta y tres kilómetros al sur, treinta y cinco minutos. Trieste mira al mar desde la mayor plaza de Europa abierta al agua. El centro habsbúrgico es llano y se anda; el Carso de encima, no.

pt.name: Centro de Trieste
pt.about: Trinta e três quilómetros para sul, trinta e cinco minutos. Trieste olha o mar da maior praça da Europa aberta para a água. O centro habsbúrgico é plano e anda-se a pé; o Carso acima, não.

fr.name: Centre de Trieste
fr.about: Trente-trois kilomètres au sud, trente-cinq minutes. Trieste regarde la mer depuis la plus grande place d'Europe ouverte sur l'eau. Le centre habsbourgeois est plat et se parcourt à pied ; le Carso au-dessus, non.

destinations.name: Udine
destinations.about: Forty kilometres north, forty minutes. Udine was the Venetian capital of Friuli and the main square still looks it. Tiepolo painted the archbishop's palace before he was famous.

es.name: Udine
es.about: Cuarenta kilómetros al norte, cuarenta minutos. Udine fue la capital veneciana del Friuli y la plaza mayor lo sigue pareciendo. Tiepolo pintó el palacio arzobispal antes de ser famoso.

pt.name: Udine
pt.about: Quarenta quilómetros para norte, quarenta minutos. Udine foi a capital veneziana do Friuli e a praça principal ainda o parece. Tiepolo pintou o palácio arquiepiscopal antes de ser famoso.

fr.name: Udine
fr.about: Quarante kilomètres au nord, quarante minutes. Udine fut la capitale vénitienne du Frioul et la grand-place en garde l'allure. Tiepolo a peint le palais archiépiscopal avant d'être célèbre.

destinations.name: Grado
destinations.about: Twenty-five kilometres west, half an hour, the last part across a causeway through the lagoon. Grado was the Habsburg seaside resort and the early Christian mosaics in the basilica are from the sixth century.

es.name: Grado
es.about: Veinticinco kilómetros al oeste, media hora, el último tramo por una carretera elevada sobre la laguna. Grado fue el balneario de los Habsburgo y los mosaicos paleocristianos de la basílica son del siglo VI.

pt.name: Grado
pt.about: Vinte e cinco quilómetros para oeste, meia hora, o último troço por uma estrada elevada sobre a lagoa. Grado foi a estância balnear dos Habsburgo e os mosaicos paleocristãos da basílica são do século VI.

fr.name: Grado
fr.about: Vingt-cinq kilomètres à l'ouest, une demi-heure, le dernier tronçon sur une chaussée au-dessus de la lagune. Grado fut la station balnéaire des Habsbourg et les mosaïques paléochrétiennes de la basilique datent du VIe siècle.

destinations.name: Ljubljana
destinations.about: Ninety-five kilometres north-east across the Slovenian border, an hour and twenty. Closer than Venice, and the road is empty. Bring the passport — the border is open but the checks come back occasionally.

es.name: Liubliana
es.about: Noventa y cinco kilómetros al noreste, cruzando a Eslovenia, una hora y veinte. Más cerca que Venecia, y la carretera va vacía. Lleva el pasaporte: la frontera está abierta pero los controles vuelven de vez en cuando.

pt.name: Liubliana
pt.about: Noventa e cinco quilómetros para nordeste, a atravessar para a Eslovénia, uma hora e vinte. Mais perto do que Veneza, e a estrada vai vazia. Leve o passaporte: a fronteira está aberta mas os controlos voltam de vez em quando.

fr.name: Ljubljana
fr.about: Quatre-vingt-quinze kilomètres au nord-est, en passant en Slovénie, une heure vingt. Plus près que Venise, et la route est vide. Prenez le passeport : la frontière est ouverte mais les contrôles reviennent parfois.

destinations.name: Venice
destinations.about: A hundred and fifty kilometres west, an hour and three quarters. Long, and the train is usually better. The car makes sense for a group, or for an arrival after the last service.

es.name: Venecia
es.about: Ciento cincuenta kilómetros al oeste, una hora y tres cuartos. Es largo y el tren suele ser mejor. El coche tiene sentido en grupo, o si llegas después del último servicio.

pt.name: Veneza
pt.about: Cento e cinquenta quilómetros para oeste, uma hora e três quartos. É longo e o comboio costuma ser melhor. O carro faz sentido em grupo, ou se chegar depois do último serviço.

fr.name: Venise
fr.about: Cent cinquante kilomètres à l'ouest, une heure trois quarts. C'est long et le train est souvent préférable. La voiture se justifie en groupe, ou après le dernier service.

es.name: Aeropuerto de Trieste
es.about: Ronchi dei Legionari sits between Trieste and Udine, thirty-three kilometres from each. It serves a corner of Italy that borders Slovenia and Austria, and Ljubljana is closer than Venice.

airports.name: Ancona Airport
airports.about: Falconara is eighteen kilometres from Ancona, on the Adriatic coast. It is a small airport serving Le Marche — a region of hill towns and a coastline that Italians use and foreigners mostly do not.
tips: Eighteen kilometres to Ancona, twenty-five minutes.
Ancona is a ferry port for Croatia, Greece and Albania.
The Conero riviera, with the best beaches on this coast, starts fifteen kilometres south of the city.
local: A ferry port people fly to
Ancona sails to Split, Patras and Igoumenitsa. If you are catching a boat, tell us the sailing — check-in closes two hours before, not one.
The Conero
A limestone headland with beaches at its foot, some reachable only by boat or a steep path. Sirolo and Numana are the towns; both fill in August.
Urbino, over the hills
Eighty kilometres inland, an hour and ten. A Renaissance ducal palace and a university, on a hilltop that has not changed much since Raphael was born there.
compare: The station is a walk from the terminal. Hourly service.
Direct to the station and port.
Few taxis. They go quickly after an arrival.

destinations.name: Ancona city centre
destinations.about: Eighteen kilometres south along the coast, twenty-five minutes. Ancona is a working port with a Roman arch on the quay and a cathedral on the hill above it. The ferry terminal is a kilometre from the centre.

es.name: Centro de Ancona
es.about: Dieciocho kilómetros al sur por la costa, veinticinco minutos. Ancona es un puerto de trabajo con un arco romano en el muelle y una catedral en la colina. La terminal de ferris está a un kilómetro del centro.

pt.name: Centro de Ancona
pt.about: Dezoito quilómetros para sul pela costa, vinte e cinco minutos. Ancona é um porto de trabalho com um arco romano no cais e uma catedral na colina. O terminal de ferries fica a um quilómetro do centro.

fr.name: Centre d'Ancône
fr.about: Dix-huit kilomètres au sud le long de la côte, vingt-cinq minutes. Ancône est un port de travail avec un arc romain sur le quai et une cathédrale sur la colline. Le terminal des ferries est à un kilomètre du centre.

destinations.name: Senigallia
destinations.about: Twenty-five kilometres north, half an hour. Thirteen kilometres of fine sand — the velvet beach — and a Renaissance fortress behind it. Popular with Italians and almost unknown to everyone else.

es.name: Senigallia
es.about: Veinticinco kilómetros al norte, media hora. Trece kilómetros de arena fina —la playa de terciopelo— y una fortaleza renacentista detrás. Muy popular entre italianos y casi desconocida fuera.

pt.name: Senigallia
pt.about: Vinte e cinco quilómetros para norte, meia hora. Treze quilómetros de areia fina — a praia de veludo — e uma fortaleza renascentista atrás. Muito popular entre italianos e quase desconhecida lá fora.

fr.name: Senigallia
fr.about: Vingt-cinq kilomètres au nord, une demi-heure. Treize kilomètres de sable fin — la plage de velours — et une forteresse Renaissance derrière. Très prisée des Italiens et presque inconnue ailleurs.

destinations.name: Urbino
destinations.about: Eighty kilometres inland, an hour and ten. A Renaissance ducal palace on a hilltop, and the town Raphael was born in. The centre is steep and closed to cars; the car park is below the walls.

es.name: Urbino
es.about: Ochenta kilómetros tierra adentro, una hora y diez. Un palacio ducal renacentista en lo alto de una colina, y el pueblo donde nació Rafael. El centro es empinado y está cerrado al tráfico.

pt.name: Urbino
pt.about: Oitenta quilómetros para o interior, uma hora e dez. Um palácio ducal renascentista no alto de uma colina, e a vila onde Rafael nasceu. O centro é íngreme e está fechado ao trânsito.

fr.name: Urbino
fr.about: Quatre-vingts kilomètres dans l'intérieur, une heure dix. Un palais ducal Renaissance au sommet d'une colline, et la ville natale de Raphaël. Le centre est raide et fermé à la circulation.

destinations.name: Riviera del Conero
destinations.about: Thirty kilometres south, thirty-five minutes. A limestone headland with beaches at its foot, some reached only by boat or a steep path. Sirolo and Numana are the towns, and both fill in August.

es.name: Riviera del Conero
es.about: Treinta kilómetros al sur, treinta y cinco minutos. Un promontorio calizo con playas al pie, algunas solo alcanzables en barco o por un sendero empinado. Sirolo y Numana son los pueblos, y se llenan en agosto.

pt.name: Riviera del Conero
pt.about: Trinta quilómetros para sul, trinta e cinco minutos. Um promontório calcário com praias ao fundo, algumas só alcançáveis de barco ou por um trilho íngreme. Sirolo e Numana são as vilas, e enchem em agosto.

fr.name: Riviera del Conero
fr.about: Trente kilomètres au sud, trente-cinq minutes. Un promontoire calcaire avec des plages en contrebas, certaines accessibles seulement en bateau ou par un sentier raide. Sirolo et Numana sont les villages.

destinations.name: Perugia
destinations.about: A hundred and fifty kilometres south-west across the Apennines, an hour and fifty. The road tunnels through the mountains. Long, but there is no train that does it in under three hours.

es.name: Perugia
es.about: Ciento cincuenta kilómetros al suroeste cruzando los Apeninos, una hora y cincuenta. La carretera va en túnel por las montañas. Es largo, pero no hay tren que lo haga en menos de tres horas.

pt.name: Perúgia
pt.about: Cento e cinquenta quilómetros para sudoeste pelos Apeninos, uma hora e cinquenta. A estrada vai em túnel pelas montanhas. É longo, mas não há comboio que o faça em menos de três horas.

fr.name: Pérouse
fr.about: Cent cinquante kilomètres au sud-ouest à travers les Apennins, une heure cinquante. La route est en tunnel sous les montagnes. C'est long, mais aucun train ne fait le trajet en moins de trois heures.

airports.name: Perugia Airport
airports.about: San Francesco d'Assisi is thirteen kilometres from Perugia and fifteen from Assisi. It is small — a handful of flights a day — and it serves the green middle of Italy, where the hill towns are and the crowds are not.
tips: Fifteen kilometres to Assisi, twenty minutes.
Perugia's centre is on a hill and reached by escalators built into the old fortress.
Flights are few. Check the schedule before assuming there is one on your day.
local: Assisi is closer than Perugia
Fifteen kilometres against thirteen, but the road to Assisi is quicker. The basilica is at the top of the town and cars stop below it.
Perugia's escalators
The centre sits two hundred metres above the valley. A series of escalators runs up through the Rocca Paolina, a fortress the city built over. The car park at the bottom is where transfers end.
Umbria without the queues
Spoleto, Gubbio, Todi and Orvieto are all within eighty kilometres. Tuscany's hill towns with a fraction of the visitors.
compare: Timed to flights only. Few services.
Very few taxis. They leave quickly.
ZTL in every hill town. Parking is at the bottom, always.

destinations.name: Perugia city centre
destinations.about: Thirteen kilometres, twenty minutes. The centre sits two hundred metres above the valley and is reached by escalators built up through the Rocca Paolina, a fortress the city grew over. Cars stop at the bottom.

es.name: Centro de Perugia
es.about: Trece kilómetros, veinte minutos. El centro está doscientos metros por encima del valle y se sube por escaleras mecánicas dentro de la Rocca Paolina, una fortaleza sobre la que creció la ciudad. Los coches paran abajo.

pt.name: Centro de Perúgia
pt.about: Treze quilómetros, vinte minutos. O centro fica duzentos metros acima do vale e sobe-se por escadas rolantes dentro da Rocca Paolina, uma fortaleza sobre a qual a cidade cresceu. Os carros param em baixo.

fr.name: Centre de Pérouse
fr.about: Treize kilomètres, vingt minutes. Le centre est deux cents mètres au-dessus de la vallée et s'atteint par des escaliers mécaniques dans la Rocca Paolina, une forteresse sur laquelle la ville a poussé.

destinations.name: Assisi
destinations.about: Fifteen kilometres east, twenty minutes. The basilica is at the top of the town and cars stop below it. Assisi fills with pilgrims on feast days and empties completely in the evening.

es.name: Asís
es.about: Quince kilómetros al este, veinte minutos. La basílica está en lo alto del pueblo y los coches paran debajo. Asís se llena de peregrinos en las fiestas y se vacía del todo al anochecer.

pt.name: Assis
pt.about: Quinze quilómetros para leste, vinte minutos. A basílica fica no alto da vila e os carros param abaixo. Assis enche de peregrinos nas festas e esvazia-se por completo ao anoitecer.

fr.name: Assise
fr.about: Quinze kilomètres à l'est, vingt minutes. La basilique est en haut du village et les voitures s'arrêtent en dessous. Assise se remplit de pèlerins les jours de fête et se vide entièrement le soir.

destinations.name: Spoleto
destinations.about: Fifty-five kilometres south, fifty minutes. A Roman theatre, a Lombard bridge across a gorge, and a festival every summer that brings the world here for three weeks.

es.name: Spoleto
es.about: Cincuenta y cinco kilómetros al sur, cincuenta minutos. Un teatro romano, un puente lombardo sobre un barranco, y un festival cada verano que trae aquí al mundo entero durante tres semanas.

pt.name: Spoleto
pt.about: Cinquenta e cinco quilómetros para sul, cinquenta minutos. Um teatro romano, uma ponte lombarda sobre uma ravina, e um festival todos os verões que traz aqui o mundo inteiro durante três semanas.

fr.name: Spolète
fr.about: Cinquante-cinq kilomètres au sud, cinquante minutes. Un théâtre romain, un pont lombard au-dessus d'un ravin, et un festival estival qui y attire le monde entier trois semaines durant.

destinations.name: Orvieto
destinations.about: Eighty kilometres south-west, an hour and ten. The town sits on a plug of volcanic rock and cars cannot climb the last stretch — the drop-off is at the funicular or the Campo della Fiera car park.

es.name: Orvieto
es.about: Ochenta kilómetros al suroeste, una hora y diez. El pueblo está sobre una roca volcánica y los coches no suben el último tramo: la parada es en el funicular o en el aparcamiento de Campo della Fiera.

pt.name: Orvieto
pt.about: Oitenta quilómetros para sudoeste, uma hora e dez. A vila fica sobre uma rocha vulcânica e os carros não sobem o último troço: a paragem é no funicular ou no parque do Campo della Fiera.

fr.name: Orvieto
fr.about: Quatre-vingts kilomètres au sud-ouest, une heure dix. La ville est perchée sur un rocher volcanique et les voitures ne montent pas le dernier tronçon : la dépose se fait au funiculaire ou au parking Campo della Fiera.

destinations.name: Gubbio
destinations.about: Fifty kilometres north, forty-five minutes. Gubbio climbs a mountainside in grey stone and looks much as it did in 1400. The Corsa dei Ceri in May is one of the oldest festivals in Italy.

es.name: Gubbio
es.about: Cincuenta kilómetros al norte, cuarenta y cinco minutos. Gubbio trepa por la ladera en piedra gris y se parece bastante a lo que era en 1400. La Corsa dei Ceri de mayo es de las fiestas más antiguas de Italia.

pt.name: Gubbio
pt.about: Cinquenta quilómetros para norte, quarenta e cinco minutos. Gubbio trepa a encosta em pedra cinzenta e parece-se bastante com o que era em 1400. A Corsa dei Ceri de maio é das festas mais antigas de Itália.

fr.name: Gubbio
fr.about: Cinquante kilomètres au nord, quarante-cinq minutes. Gubbio grimpe le flanc de la montagne en pierre grise et ressemble beaucoup à ce qu'elle était en 1400. La Corsa dei Ceri de mai est l'une des plus vieilles fêtes d'Italie.
